```{r}
##### Libraries ---------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(haven)
  library(readxl)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(countrycode)
  library(data.table)
})

##### ---- Paths (EDIT these) -------------------------------------------------
ivs_path    <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/Integrated_values_surveys_1981-2022.dta"
fr_csv_path <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/illibpopculsup_parties.csv"
dict_path   <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/IVS/Common_EVS_WVS_Dictionary_EVS-Trend.xlsx"

##### ---- Utilities ----------------------------------------------------------
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

extract_year <- function(x){
  if (is.numeric(x)) { y <- floor(x); y %% 10000 } else {
    first <- stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d{4}"); suppressWarnings(as.integer(first))
  }
}

neg_codes <- c(-1L,-2L,-3L,-4L,-5L)
clean_num <- function(x) {
  xi <- as.integer(haven::zap_labels(x))
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_integer_
  xi
}

read_dictionary_all <- function(path){
  sh <- readxl::excel_sheets(path)
  suppressMessages(map_dfr(sh, ~ readxl::read_excel(path, .x) |> mutate(.sheet = .x), .id = ".__sheet_id"))
}

safe_filename <- function(x) {
  x %>% stringr::str_replace_all("[/\\\\:*?\"<>|]", "_") %>% stringr::str_replace_all("\\s+", "_")
}

# ---- Collapse GB and GB-GBN to the same country code
normalize_s009 <- function(x) {
  y <- as.character(x)
  y[y %in% c("GB-GBN","UK")] <- "GB"
  y
}

# ---- Ideology buckets (E033 → Left/CL/CR/Right; denominator = ALL with ideology)
add_ideology4 <- function(df){
  e <- as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(df$E033))
  df$ideol4 <- factor(dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(e) ~ NA_character_,
    e <= 2.5 ~ "Left",
    e <= 5   ~ "Center-left",
    e < 7.5  ~ "Center-right",
    TRUE     ~ "Right"
  ), levels = c("Left","Center-left","Center-right","Right"))
  df
}

# ---- Country-specific income (1–10) with X047 fallback → 4 fixed bands
income_text_regex <- paste0(
  "(income\\s*(scale|group|decile))|",
  "(lowest\\s+income\\s+group)|(highest\\s+income\\s+group)|",
  "(your\\s+household.*income.*1\\s*[^0-9]*\\s*10)"
)

get_income_vars_from_dictionary <- function(path, ivs_names) {
  if (is.null(path) || !file.exists(path)) return(character(0))
  dict <- read_dictionary_all(path); if (!nrow(dict)) return(character(0))
  dict_chr <- dict |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  rows <- dict_chr |> dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_any(everything(), ~ str_detect(tolower(.x), income_text_regex)))
  if (!nrow(rows)) return(character(0))
  toks <- rows |> pivot_longer(everything(), values_to = "val") |>
    transmute(val = as.character(val)) |> filter(!is.na(val), nzchar(val)) |> distinct(val) |> pull(val)
  intersect(toks, ivs_names)
}

get_income_vars_from_ivs_labels <- function(df) {
  nm <- names(df)
  lab <- function(v) tolower(attr(df[[v]], "label", exact = TRUE) %||% "")
  looks_1to10 <- function(v) any(df[[v]] %in% 1:10, na.rm = TRUE)
  cand <- purrr::keep(nm, ~ {
    lt <- lab(.x)
    (str_detect(lt, income_text_regex) || str_detect(lt, "household.*income")) && looks_1to10(.x)
  })
  cand <- setdiff(cand, c("X047_EVS","X047_WVS")) |> c(cand, intersect(c("X047_EVS","X047_WVS"), nm))
  unique(cand)
}

mk_income_country_specific <- function(df, dict_path, use_x047_fallback = TRUE, verbose = TRUE){
  ivs_names <- names(df)
  cand <- get_income_vars_from_dictionary(dict_path, ivs_names)
  if (!length(cand)) {
    if (verbose) message("Income: dictionary scan found none; falling back to IVS labels …")
    cand <- get_income_vars_from_ivs_labels(df)
  }
  if (!length(cand) && use_x047_fallback) cand <- intersect(c("X047_EVS","X047_WVS"), ivs_names)
  if (!length(cand)) stop("Income: could not locate any country-specific income variables.")

  mats <- lapply(cand, function(v){
    x <- df[[v]]
    xi <- if (haven::is.labelled(x) || is.factor(x)) as.integer(haven::zap_labels(x)) else suppressWarnings(as.integer(x))
    xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_integer_
    xi[!(xi >= 1L & xi <= 10L)] <- NA_integer_
    xi
  })
  income_10 <- purrr::reduce(mats, coalesce)
  mat <- do.call(cbind, mats)
  idx <- apply(mat, 1, function(row){ w <- which(!is.na(row)); if (length(w)) w[1] else NA_integer_ })
  tibble(
    income_10     = income_10,
    income_source = factor(ifelse(is.na(idx), NA, cand[idx]), levels = cand)
  )
}

add_income_bands_fixed <- function(df){
  df %>%
    mutate(
      income_band = case_when(
        is.na(income_10) ~ NA_character_,
        income_10 <= 2   ~ "Lower (1–2)",
        income_10 <= 5   ~ "Lower-middle (3–5)",
        income_10 <= 7   ~ "Upper-middle (6–7)",
        TRUE             ~ "Upper (8–10)"
      ),
      income_band = factor(income_band,
        levels = c("Lower (1–2)","Lower-middle (3–5)","Upper-middle (6–7)","Upper (8–10)")
      )
    )
}

# ---- PDF helper (prevents orphaned devices)
make_pdf <- function(file, expr, width = 11, height = 8.5) {
  dir.create(dirname(file), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  grDevices::pdf(file, width = width, height = height)
  on.exit(try(grDevices::dev.off(), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  force(expr)
}

##### ---- Load IVS (memory-safe) --------------------------------------------
# Only read the columns we actually use
needed_cols <- c(
  "S009", "S025",           # country code, year field
  "E033",                   # ideology self-placement
  "E179WVS", "E179",        # WVS party ids
  "E181A",  "E181C",          # EVS party id (if present)
  "X047_EVS", "X047_WVS"    # common income fallbacks (1–10)
)

ivs <- haven::read_dta(ivs_path, col_select = tidyselect::any_of(needed_cols))

# sanity check
message("Loaded columns: ", paste(names(ivs), collapse = ", "))


# Country code (CHAR, normalized) and labels for titles
cty_lookup <- tibble(S009_code = normalize_s009(ivs$S009)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(country_label = countrycode(S009_code, "iso2c", "country.name"),
         country_label = ifelse(is.na(country_label), paste0("Country_", S009_code), country_label))

##### ---- Build IVS micro base -----------------------------------------------
# Detect the EVS party-id variable (works across waves: A/C/etc.)
evs_var  <- intersect(names(ivs), c("E181C","E181_EVS","E181A","E181","E181EVS","E181_EV"))
E181_num <- if (length(evs_var)) clean_num(ivs[[evs_var[1]]]) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(ivs))

# If your later code still references E181A_num, keep a back-compat alias:
E181A_num <- E181_num

full_ivs <- ivs %>%
  mutate(
    S009_code    = normalize_s009(S009),
    year         = extract_year(S025),
    E179WVS_num  = clean_num(E179WVS),
    E179_num     = clean_num(E179),
    E181A_num    = E181A_num,
    # Respondent's party choice; may be NA (and stays NA)
    wvs_id_final = coalesce(E179WVS_num, E179_num, E181A_num)
  ) %>%
  add_ideology4() %>%
  bind_cols(mk_income_country_specific(., dict_path, use_x047_fallback = TRUE)) %>%
  add_income_bands_fixed() %>%
  left_join(cty_lookup, by = "S009_code")

##### ---- Far-right parties: read CSV & tag respondents (EVS vs WVS IDs) ----
fr_raw <- readr::read_csv(fr_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename_with(tolower)

# Find id columns robustly
pick_first <- function(nms, pats) {
  hit <- unlist(lapply(pats, function(p) grep(p, nms, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)))
  if (length(hit)) nms[hit[1]] else NA_character_
}
wvs_col <- pick_first(names(fr_raw), c("^wvs[_ ]?id$", "^wvsid$"))
evs_col <- pick_first(names(fr_raw), c("^evs[_ ]?id$", "^evsid$"))

if (is.na(wvs_col) && is.na(evs_col)) {
  stop("Your CSV must have a WVS id (wvs_id) and/or an EVS id (evs_id) column.")
}

# Optional party name if present (used later for labels)
name_col <- pick_first(names(fr_raw), c("^party(_name)?$", "^name$"))

fr_ids <- fr_raw %>%
  transmute(
    wvs_id = if (!is.na(wvs_col)) as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[[wvs_col]]))) else NA_integer_,
    evs_id = if (!is.na(evs_col)) as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[[evs_col]]))) else NA_integer_,
    party_name = if (!is.na(name_col)) as.character(.data[[name_col]]) else NA_character_
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wvs_id) | !is.na(evs_id)) %>%
  distinct()

fr_wvs_ids <- fr_ids %>% filter(!is.na(wvs_id)) %>% pull(wvs_id) %>% unique()
fr_evs_ids <- fr_ids %>% filter(!is.na(evs_id)) %>% pull(evs_id) %>% unique()

# For each respondent: which field supplied their party code?
# (Your coalesce order means: E179WVS first, then E179, then E181A)
full_ivs <- full_ivs %>%
  mutate(
    party_source = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(E179WVS_num)                     ~ "WVS",
      is.na(E179WVS_num) & !is.na(E179_num)   ~ "WVS",
      is.na(E179WVS_num) & is.na(E179_num) & !is.na(E181A_num) ~ "EVS",
      TRUE                                    ~ NA_character_
    ),
    resp_party_id = dplyr::case_when(
      party_source == "EVS" ~ E181A_num,
      party_source == "WVS" ~ dplyr::coalesce(E179WVS_num, E179_num),
      TRUE                  ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

# Raw far-right match: EVS rows use evs_id; WVS rows use wvs_id
full_ivs <- full_ivs %>%
  mutate(
    far_right_raw = dplyr::case_when(
      party_source == "EVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_evs_ids ~ 1L,
      party_source == "WVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_wvs_ids ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  )

# (b) “Once FR, then always FR” within country, from the first observed FR year on
first_fr_by_ctry_party <- full_ivs %>%
  filter(far_right_raw == 1L, !is.na(resp_party_id)) %>%
  group_by(S009_code, party_source, resp_party_id) %>%
  summarise(first_fr_year = min(year, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ivspicks <- full_ivs %>%
  left_join(first_fr_by_ctry_party,
            by = c("S009_code","party_source","resp_party_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    far_right_consistent = as.integer(!is.na(first_fr_year) & year >= first_fr_year)
  ) %>%
  select(S009_code, country_label, year, ideol4, income_band,
         party_source, resp_party_id, far_right_raw, far_right_consistent)

# Optional: if you want party names on last-wave tables later
fr_party_names <- fr_ids %>%
  select(wvs_id, evs_id, party_name) %>%
  distinct()

##### ---- Country–year presence of any far-right choice -----------------------
cty_year_presence <- ivspicks %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label, year) %>%
  summarise(presence_any = any(far_right_consistent == 1L, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

waves_per_country <- cty_year_presence %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_waves_with_far_right = sum(presence_any, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_waves_total          = n_distinct(year),
    years_with_far_right   = paste(sort(unique(year[presence_any])), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_waves_with_far_right), country_label)

##### ---- % far-right by ideology (DENOMINATOR = all with ideology) ----------
# Keep only what we need; make types compact
ivs_slim <- ivspicks %>%
  transmute(
    S009_code = as.character(S009_code),
    year      = as.integer(year),
    ideol4    = as.character(ideol4),              # compact for grouping
    fr        = as.integer(replace_na(far_right_consistent, 0L))
  )

setDT(ivs_slim)

# Grouped counts (denominator = ALL with ideology, even if no party named)
nat_dt <- ivs_slim[!is.na(ideol4),
  .(n_total = .N, n_far_right = sum(fr == 1L)),
  by = .(S009_code, year, ideol4)
][
  , pct_far_right := 100 * n_far_right / pmax(n_total, 1)
][
  order(S009_code, year, ideol4)
]

# Attach country labels AFTER the aggregation to avoid string bloat
lab_dt <- as.data.table(unique(cty_lookup[, c("S009_code","country_label")]))
nat_dt  <- lab_dt[nat_dt, on = .(S009_code)]

# Back to tibble if you prefer
nat_stats <- as_tibble(nat_dt) %>%
  relocate(S009_code, country_label, year, ideol4, n_total, n_far_right, pct_far_right)

# Wide layout (one row per country-year with 4 ideology columns)
nat_stats_wide <- nat_stats %>%
  select(country_label, S009_code, year, ideol4, pct_far_right) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = ideol4,
    values_from = pct_far_right,
    names_prefix = "pct_"
  ) %>%
  relocate(country_label, S009_code, year)

##### ---- Income breakdown among FAR-RIGHT voters (per country-year) ---------
fr_income_comp <- ivspicks %>%
  filter(far_right_consistent == 1L, !is.na(income_band)) %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label, year, income_band) %>%
  summarise(fr_n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(share_among_FR = 100 * fr_n / pmax(sum(fr_n), 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% arrange(S009_code, year, income_band)

##### ---- Income composition of each ideology group (per country-year) -------
# Keep only what we need, as compact types
ideo_slim <- full_ivs %>%
  transmute(
    S009_code   = as.character(S009_code),
    year        = as.integer(year),
    ideol4      = as.character(ideol4),
    income_band = as.character(income_band)
  )

setDT(ideo_slim)

# Count per (country-year-ideology-income_band)
counts <- ideo_slim[!is.na(ideol4) & !is.na(income_band),
  .(n = .N),
  by = .(S009_code, year, ideol4, income_band)
]

# Totals per (country-year-ideology)
totals <- counts[, .(n_total = sum(n)), by = .(S009_code, year, ideol4)]

# Shares + tidy ordering
ideo_dt <- counts[totals, on = .(S009_code, year, ideol4)][
  , share_in_band := 100 * n / pmax(n_total, 1)
][order(S009_code, year, ideol4, income_band)]

# Join country labels AFTER aggregation to avoid string bloat
lab_dt <- as.data.table(unique(cty_lookup[, c("S009_code","country_label")]))
ideo_dt <- lab_dt[ideo_dt, on = .(S009_code)]

# Back to tibble if you prefer
ideo_income_comp_long <- as_tibble(ideo_dt) %>%
  relocate(S009_code, country_label, year, ideol4, income_band, n, n_total, share_in_band)

ideo_income_comp_wide <- ideo_income_comp_long %>%
  select(country_label, S009_code, year, ideol4, income_band, share_in_band) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = income_band,
    values_from = share_in_band
  ) %>%
  relocate(country_label, S009_code, year, ideol4)

# Optional: attach party names from CSV if present
party_map <- bind_rows(
  fr_ids %>% filter(!is.na(wvs_id)) %>% transmute(party_source = "WVS", resp_party_id = wvs_id, party_name),
  fr_ids %>% filter(!is.na(evs_id)) %>% transmute(party_source = "EVS", resp_party_id = evs_id, party_name)
) %>% distinct(party_source, resp_party_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

##### ---- Plotters ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_country_ideology <- function(cty_code, nat_df) {
  d <- nat_df %>% filter(S009_code == cty_code, !is.na(pct_far_right))
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  ggplot(d, aes(year, pct_far_right, color = ideol4, group = ideol4)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Far-right vote intention (of ideology group): ", d$country_label[1]),
      x = "Year", y = "% far-right",
      color = "Ideology"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() + ylim(0, 100)
}

plot_country_fr_income <- function(cty_code, comp_df) {
  d <- comp_df %>% filter(S009_code == cty_code)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  ggplot(d, aes(x = factor(year), y = share_among_FR, fill = income_band)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Income composition among far-right voters: ", d$country_label[1]),
      x = "Year", y = "% (FR voters)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Income band")) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100))
}

##### ---- Outputs -------------------------------------------------------------
dir.create("out/plots", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("out/csv",   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("out/presence", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# CSVs
write_csv(nat_stats,                 "out/csv/country_year_ideology_far_right_LONG.csv")
write_csv(nat_stats_wide,            "out/csv/country_year_ideology_far_right_WIDE.csv")
write_csv(fr_income_comp,            "out/csv/country_year_FR_income_composition.csv")
write_csv(ideo_income_comp_long,     "out/csv/country_year_ideology_income_composition_LONG.csv")
write_csv(ideo_income_comp_wide,     "out/csv/country_year_ideology_income_composition_WIDE.csv")
write_csv(cty_year_presence,         "out/presence/country_year_far_right_presence.csv")
write_csv(waves_per_country,         "out/presence/waves_with_far_right_by_country.csv")

# National PDFs
plot_codes <- sort(unique(nat_stats$S009_code))

make_pdf("out/plots/NATIONAL_ideology_far_right.pdf",
         expr = { walk(plot_codes, ~ print(plot_country_ideology(.x, nat_stats))) })

make_pdf("out/plots/NATIONAL_FR_income_composition.pdf",
         expr = { walk(plot_codes, ~ print(plot_country_fr_income(.x, fr_income_comp))) })

# Optional: per-country PNGs
walk(plot_codes, ~ {
  nm <- cty_lookup$country_label[match(.x, cty_lookup$S009_code)]
  ggsave(file.path("out/plots", paste0("ideology_far_right_", safe_filename(nm), ".png")),
         plot_country_ideology(.x, nat_stats), width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path("out/plots", paste0("FR_income_comp_", safe_filename(nm), ".png")),
         plot_country_fr_income(.x, fr_income_comp), width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
})

message("Done. Plots and CSVs written to 'out/'.")
```

fr_csv_path       <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/illibpopculsup_parties.csv"

dict_path         <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/IVS/Common_EVS_WVS_Dictionary_EVS-Trend.xlsx"

##### ---- Utilities ----------------------------------------------------------
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

extract_year <- function(x){
  if (is.numeric(x)) { y <- floor(x); y %% 10000 } else {
    first <- stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d{4}"); suppressWarnings(as.integer(first))
  }
}

neg_codes <- c(-1L,-2L,-3L,-4L,-5L)
clean_num <- function(x) {
  xi <- as.integer(haven::zap_labels(x))
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_integer_
  xi
}

read_dictionary_all <- function(path){
  sh <- readxl::excel_sheets(path)
  suppressMessages(map_dfr(sh, ~ readxl::read_excel(path, .x) |> mutate(.sheet = .x), .id = ".__sheet_id"))
}

safe_filename <- function(x) {
  x %>% stringr::str_replace_all("[/\\\\:*?\"<>|]", "_") %>% stringr::str_replace_all("\\s+", "_")
}

# ---- Collapse GB and GB-GBN to the same country code
normalize_s009 <- function(x) {
  y <- as.character(x)
  y[y %in% c("GB-GBN","UK")] <- "GB"
  y
}

# ---- Ideology buckets (E033 → Left/CL/CR/Right)
add_ideology4 <- function(df){
  e <- as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(df$E033))
  df$ideol4 <- factor(dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(e) ~ NA_character_,
    e <= 2.5 ~ "Left",
    e <= 5   ~ "Center-left",
    e < 7.5  ~ "Center-right",
    TRUE     ~ "Right"
  ), levels = c("Left","Center-left","Center-right","Right"))
  df
}

# ---- Country-specific income (1–10) with X047 fallback → 4 fixed bands
income_text_regex <- paste0(
  "(income\\s*(scale|group|decile))|",
  "(lowest\\s+income\\s+group)|(highest\\s+income\\s+group)|",
  "(your\\s+household.*income.*1\\s*[^0-9]*\\s*10)"
)

get_income_vars_from_dictionary <- function(path, ivs_names) {
  if (is.null(path) || !file.exists(path)) return(character(0))
  dict <- read_dictionary_all(path); if (!nrow(dict)) return(character(0))
  dict_chr <- dict |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  rows <- dict_chr |> dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_any(everything(), ~ str_detect(tolower(.x), income_text_regex)))
  if (!nrow(rows)) return(character(0))
  toks <- rows |> pivot_longer(everything(), values_to = "val") |>
    transmute(val = as.character(val)) |> filter(!is.na(val), nzchar(val)) |> distinct(val) |> pull(val)
  intersect(toks, ivs_names)
}

get_income_vars_from_ivs_labels <- function(df) {
  nm <- names(df)
  lab <- function(v) tolower(attr(df[[v]], "label", exact = TRUE) %||% "")
  looks_1to10 <- function(v) any(df[[v]] %in% 1:10, na.rm = TRUE)
  cand <- purrr::keep(nm, ~ {
    lt <- lab(.x)
    (str_detect(lt, income_text_regex) || str_detect(lt, "household.*income")) && looks_1to10(.x)
  })
  cand <- setdiff(cand, c("X047_EVS","X047_WVS")) |> c(cand, intersect(c("X047_EVS","X047_WVS"), nm))
  unique(cand)
}

mk_income_country_specific <- function(df, dict_path, use_x047_fallback = TRUE, verbose = TRUE){
  ivs_names <- names(df)
  cand <- get_income_vars_from_dictionary(dict_path, ivs_names)
  if (!length(cand)) {
    if (verbose) message("Income: dictionary scan found none; falling back to IVS labels …")
    cand <- get_income_vars_from_ivs_labels(df)
  }
  if (!length(cand) && use_x047_fallback) cand <- intersect(c("X047_EVS","X047_WVS"), ivs_names)
  if (!length(cand)) stop("Income: could not locate any country-specific income variables.")

  mats <- lapply(cand, function(v){
    x <- df[[v]]
    xi <- if (haven::is.labelled(x) || is.factor(x)) as.integer(haven::zap_labels(x)) else suppressWarnings(as.integer(x))
    xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_integer_
    xi[!(xi >= 1L & xi <= 10L)] <- NA_integer_
    xi
  })
  income_10 <- purrr::reduce(mats, coalesce)
  mat <- do.call(cbind, mats)
  idx <- apply(mat, 1, function(row){ w <- which(!is.na(row)); if (length(w)) w[1] else NA_integer_ })
  tibble(
    income_10     = income_10,
    income_source = factor(ifelse(is.na(idx), NA, cand[idx]), levels = cand)
  )
}

add_income_bands_fixed <- function(df){
  df %>%
    mutate(
      income_band = case_when(
        is.na(income_10) ~ NA_character_,
        income_10 <= 2   ~ "Lower (1–2)",
        income_10 <= 5   ~ "Lower-middle (3–5)",
        income_10 <= 7   ~ "Upper-middle (6–7)",
        TRUE             ~ "Upper (8–10)"
      ),
      income_band = factor(income_band,
        levels = c("Lower (1–2)","Lower-middle (3–5)","Upper-middle (6–7)","Upper (8–10)")
      )
    )
}

# ---- PDF helper (prevents orphaned devices)
make_pdf <- function(file, expr, width = 11, height = 8.5) {
  dir.create(dirname(file), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  grDevices::pdf(file, width = width, height = height)
  on.exit(try(grDevices::dev.off(), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  force(expr)
}

##### ---- Load IVS (memory-safe: only needed cols) ---------------------------
needed_cols <- c(
  "S009","S025",         # country code, year field
  "E033",                # ideology
  "E179WVS","E179",      # WVS party ids
  "E181A","E181C",       # EVS party id (waves differ)
  "E035",                # egalitarianism / inequality scale
  "X047_EVS","X047_WVS"  # income fallbacks if needed
)
ivs <- haven::read_dta(ivs_path, col_select = tidyselect::any_of(needed_cols))
message("Loaded columns: ", paste(names(ivs), collapse = ", "))

# Country labels
cty_lookup <- tibble(S009_code = normalize_s009(ivs$S009)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(country_label = countrycode(S009_code, "iso2c", "country.name"),
         country_label = ifelse(is.na(country_label), paste0("Country_", S009_code), country_label))

##### ---- Build IVS micro base -----------------------------------------------
# Detect the EVS party-id variable (works across waves: C, A, etc.)
evs_var  <- intersect(names(ivs), c("E181C","E181_EVS","E181A","E181","E181EVS","E181_EV"))
E181_num <- if (length(evs_var)) clean_num(ivs[[evs_var[1]]]) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(ivs))
E181A_num <- E181_num  # back-compat alias for later code

full_ivs <- ivs %>%
  mutate(
    S009_code    = normalize_s009(S009),
    year         = extract_year(S025),
    E179WVS_num  = clean_num(E179WVS),
    E179_num     = clean_num(E179),
    E181A_num    = E181A_num,
    E035_num     = if ("E035" %in% names(ivs)) clean_num(E035) else NA_integer_,
    # Respondent's party choice; may be NA
    wvs_id_final = coalesce(E179WVS_num, E179_num, E181A_num)
  ) %>%
  add_ideology4() %>%
  bind_cols(mk_income_country_specific(., dict_path, use_x047_fallback = TRUE)) %>%
  add_income_bands_fixed() %>%
  left_join(cty_lookup, by = "S009_code")

# Party source + respondent party id (for EVS/WVS split)
full_ivs <- full_ivs %>%
  mutate(
    party_source = case_when(
      !is.na(E179WVS_num)                     ~ "WVS",
      is.na(E179WVS_num) & !is.na(E179_num)   ~ "WVS",
      is.na(E179WVS_num) & is.na(E179_num) & !is.na(E181A_num) ~ "EVS",
      TRUE                                    ~ NA_character_
    ),
    resp_party_id = case_when(
      party_source == "EVS" ~ E181A_num,
      party_source == "WVS" ~ coalesce(E179WVS_num, E179_num),
      TRUE                  ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

##### ---- Far-right party IDs from TWO sources (no double-counting) ----------
# (A) illibpopculsup_parties.csv → wvs_id / evs_id
fr_raw_A <- readr::read_csv(fr_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename_with(tolower)
pick_first <- function(nms, pats) {
  hit <- unlist(lapply(pats, function(p) grep(p, nms, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)))
  if (length(hit)) nms[hit[1]] else NA_character_
}
wvs_col_A <- pick_first(names(fr_raw_A), c("^wvs[_ ]?id$", "^wvsid$"))
evs_col_A <- pick_first(names(fr_raw_A), c("^evs[_ ]?id$", "^evsid$"))
name_col_A<- pick_first(names(fr_raw_A), c("^party(_name)?$", "^name$"))

fr_ids_A <- fr_raw_A %>%
  transmute(
    wvs_id = if (!is.na(wvs_col_A)) as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[[wvs_col_A]]))) else NA_integer_,
    evs_id = if (!is.na(evs_col_A)) as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[[evs_col_A]]))) else NA_integer_,
    party_name = if (!is.na(name_col_A)) as.character(.data[[name_col_A]]) else NA_character_
  ) %>% filter(!is.na(wvs_id) | !is.na(evs_id)) %>% distinct()

fr_wvs_A <- fr_ids_A %>% filter(!is.na(wvs_id)) %>% pull(wvs_id) %>% unique()
fr_evs_A <- fr_ids_A %>% filter(!is.na(evs_id)) %>% pull(evs_id) %>% unique()

# (B) populist.csv → party_id (auto-map to WVS/EVS by overlap with respondent universes)
fr_raw_B <- readr::read_csv(populist_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename_with(tolower)
if (!"party_id" %in% names(fr_raw_B)) stop("populist.csv must contain a 'party_id' column.")
idtype_col_B <- pick_first(names(fr_raw_B), c("^id[_-]?type$", "^domain$", "^scheme$", "^source$"))

# universes seen in IVS
univ_wvs <- unique(na.omit(coalesce(full_ivs$E179WVS_num, full_ivs$E179_num)))
univ_evs <- unique(na.omit(full_ivs$E181A_num))

pop_ids <- fr_raw_B %>%
  transmute(party_id = as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[["party_id"]])))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(party_id)) %>% distinct() %>% pull(party_id)

if (!is.na(idtype_col_B)) {
  # Respect declared domain if present
  decl <- fr_raw_B %>%
    transmute(
      party_id = as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[["party_id"]]))),
      id_type  = tolower(as.character(.data[[idtype_col_B]]))
    ) %>% filter(!is.na(party_id))
  fr_wvs_B <- decl %>% filter(str_detect(id_type,"wvs")) %>% pull(party_id)
  fr_evs_B <- decl %>% filter(str_detect(id_type,"evs")) %>% pull(party_id)
} else {
  # Auto-map by overlap with respondent universes (assign where they actually match)
  fr_wvs_B <- intersect(pop_ids, univ_wvs)
  fr_evs_B <- intersect(pop_ids, univ_evs)
}

# Final de-duplicated FR sets
fr_wvs_ids <- union(fr_wvs_A, fr_wvs_B)
fr_evs_ids <- union(fr_evs_A, fr_evs_B)

##### ---- Tag FR voters (raw) + “once FR → always FR” ------------------------
full_ivs <- full_ivs %>%
  mutate(
    far_right_raw = case_when(
      party_source == "EVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_evs_ids ~ 1L,
      party_source == "WVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_wvs_ids ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  )

first_fr_by_ctry_party <- full_ivs %>%
  filter(far_right_raw == 1L, !is.na(resp_party_id)) %>%
  group_by(S009_code, party_source, resp_party_id) %>%
  summarise(first_fr_year = min(year, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ivspicks <- full_ivs %>%
  left_join(first_fr_by_ctry_party,
            by = c("S009_code","party_source","resp_party_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    far_right_consistent = as.integer(!is.na(first_fr_year) & year >= first_fr_year),
    moderate = ideol4 %in% c("Center-left","Center-right")
  ) %>%
  select(S009_code, country_label, year, ideol4, moderate,
         E035_num,                      # <--- keep to build egal/inegal split
         income_10, income_band, party_source, resp_party_id,
         far_right_raw, far_right_consistent)

##### ---- Country eligibility (any FR present at least once) -----------------
cty_year_presence <- ivspicks %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label, year) %>%
  summarise(presence_any = any(far_right_consistent == 1L, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
eligible_codes <- cty_year_presence %>%
  group_by(S009_code) %>% summarise(any = any(presence_any), .groups="drop") %>%
  filter(any) %>% pull(S009_code)

##### ---- Moderates + Left + Right overlay metrics (bars + lines) ------------
ovr_all <- ivspicks %>%
  transmute(
    S009_code = as.character(S009_code),
    year      = as.integer(year),
    ideol4    = as.character(ideol4),
    fr        = as.integer(replace_na(far_right_consistent, 0L))
  )
data.table::setDT(ovr_all)

# 3-way grouping: Left / Moderates / Right
ovr_all[, group3 :=
  fifelse(ideol4 == "Left", "Left",
  fifelse(ideol4 %chin% c("Center-left","Center-right"), "Moderates",
  fifelse(ideol4 == "Right", "Right", NA_character_)))]

counts3 <- ovr_all[!is.na(group3),
  .(n = .N, n_fr = sum(fr == 1L)),
  by = .(S009_code, year, group3)
]
totals3 <- ovr_all[, .(n_total = .N), by = .(S009_code, year)]

pct3 <- counts3[totals3, on = .(S009_code, year)][
  , `:=`(
    pct_group_of_total = 100 * n / pmax(n_total, 1),
    pct_FR_among_group = 100 * n_fr / pmax(n, 1)
  )
]

# attach labels
lab_dt <- unique(as.data.table(cty_lookup[, c("S009_code","country_label")]))
overlay_long <- lab_dt[pct3, on = .(S009_code)]
overlay_long <- overlay_long[order(S009_code, year, group3)]

##### ---- Plot: Updated overlay (Left/Moderates/Right) -----------------------
plot_country_overlay_LMR <- function(cty_code, df_long) {
  d <- df_long %>% filter(S009_code == cty_code) %>% arrange(year, group3)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(ggplot() + theme_void())

  # palettes
  fills  <- c(Left = "#1f77b4", Moderates = "grey70", Right = "#d62728")
  linesc <- fills

  ggplot(d, aes(x = year)) +
    # Bars: share of electorate by group (dodge)
    geom_col(aes(y = pct_group_of_total, fill = group3),
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.6) +
    # Lines: % FR among each group
    geom_line(aes(y = pct_FR_among_group, color = group3, group = group3),
              linewidth = 1.05) +
    geom_point(aes(y = pct_FR_among_group, color = group3),
               size = 1.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fills, name = "Group (bars)") +
    scale_color_manual(values = linesc, name = "FR among group (lines)") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Left • Moderates • Right — shares & far-right support: ", d$country_label[1]),
      x = "Year",
      y = "% (0–100)",
      subtitle = "Bars: each group's share of electorate • Lines: % of that group voting far-right"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

dir.create("out/plots", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
make_pdf("out/plots/NATIONAL_LMR_overlay.pdf", expr = {
  walk(sort(unique(overlay_long$S009_code[overlay_long$S009_code %in% eligible_codes])),
       ~ print(plot_country_overlay_LMR(.x, overlay_long)))
})

##### ---- Egalitarian vs Inegalitarian Moderates (E035) ----------------------
# Build long table for moderates split by E035
egal_slim <- ivspicks %>%
  transmute(

rates2 <- egal_slim[!is.na(group2),

][

safe_median <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else stats::median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

med_slim <- ivspicks %>%
  transmute(
    S009_code = as.character(S009_code),
    year      = as.integer(year),
    moderate  = ideol4 %in% c("Center-left","Center-right"),

med_dt <- med_slim[, .(
  n_total = .N,
  n_moderates = sum(moderate, na.rm = TRUE),
  pct_moderate_of_total = 100 * sum(moderate, na.rm = TRUE) / pmax(.N,1),
  n_moderates_FR = sum(moderate & fr == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
  pct_FR_among_moderates = 100 * sum(moderate & fr == 1L, na.rm = TRUE) /
                           pmax(sum(moderate, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
  median_income10_moderates     = safe_median(income_10[moderate == TRUE]),
  median_income10_moderates_FR  = safe_median(income_10[moderate == TRUE & fr == 1L])
), by = .(S009_code, year)]

]
