```{r}
# ==== Egalitarian (E035) categories & FR series CSV ==========================
# Preconditions: ivspicks exists and contains:
# S009_code, country_label, year, E035_num, ideol4, far_right_consistent

stopifnot(exists("ivspicks"))

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Work on a compact table
egal_dt <- ivspicks %>%
  transmute(
    S009_code     = as.character(S009_code),
    country_label = as.character(country_label),
    year          = as.integer(year),
    E035          = as.numeric(E035_num),
    ideol4        = as.character(ideol4),
    fr            = as.integer(replace_na(far_right_consistent, 0L))
  )
setDT(egal_dt)

# E035-based categories: ≤ 2.5 = Left, (2.5, 7.5) = Moderate, ≥ 7.5 = Right
egal_dt[, category := fifelse(is.na(E035), NA_character_,
                       fifelse(E035 <= 2.5, "Left",
                       fifelse(E035 >= 7.5, "Right", "Moderate")))]
# Totals per country-year (all respondents, including those with missing E035)
totals <- egal_dt[, .(n_total = .N), by = .(S009_code, country_label, year)]

# For each E035 category: size, FR count, and "ideological alignment" count
# (share of E035-Left who are ideol Left; E035-Moderates who are ideol Center-left/Center-right;
#  E035-Right who are ideol Right). Missing ideol4 are treated as non-aligned.
counts <- egal_dt[!is.na(category),
  .(
    n_group   = .N,
    n_fr      = sum(fr == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_align   = sum(
                  (category == "Left"     & ideol4 == "Left") |
                  (category == "Moderate" & ideol4 %chin% c("Center-left","Center-right")) |
                  (category == "Right"    & ideol4 == "Right"),
                  na.rm = TRUE
                )
  ),
  by = .(S009_code, country_label, year, category)
]

# Merge totals and compute percentages
m <- counts[totals, on = .(S009_code, country_label, year)]

# Safe percentage helper (NA when denom==0)
safe_pct <- function(num, denom) ifelse(is.finite(denom) & denom > 0, 100 * num / denom, NA_real_)

m[, `:=`(
  pct_of_all                   = safe_pct(n_group, n_total),
  pct_FR_among_category        = safe_pct(n_fr, n_group),
  pct_ideology_alignment_match = safe_pct(n_align, n_group)
)]

# Deltas vs previous year and vs first year (within country × category)
setorder(m, S009_code, category, year)
m[, `:=`(
  delta_prev  = pct_FR_among_category - shift(pct_FR_among_category, type = "lag"),
  delta_first = pct_FR_among_category - first(pct_FR_among_category)
), by = .(S009_code, category)]

# Final select/rename in requested order
out_egal_series <- m[, .(
  country        = country_label,
  S009_code,
  year,
  category,                                # "Left" / "Moderate" / "Right" from E035
  pct_of_all,                              # % of all respondents in this E035 category
  pct_FR_among_category,                   # % of this category voting far-right
  delta_prev,                              # Δ vs previous survey year (same country & category)
  delta_first,                             # Δ vs first observed year (same country & category)
  pct_ideology_alignment_match             # share whose ideological self-placement matches the category
)]

# Write CSV (only output)
dir.create("out/csv", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(out_egal_series, "out/csv/egalitarian_groups_far_right_by_country_year.csv")

```

```{r}
# ==== Plot pct_FR_among_category by E035 category (per country) =============
# Input CSV: change this path if needed
# input_csv_path <- "out/csv/egalitarian_groups_far_right_by_country_year.csv"
# If you're using the file you just shared to me, set e.g.:
input_csv_path <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/ed_egalitarian_groups_far_right_by_country_year.csv"

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readr)
})

# Fallback make_pdf if not already defined in your session
if (!exists("make_pdf")) {
  make_pdf <- function(file, expr, width = 11, height = 8.5) {
    dir.create(dirname(file), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    grDevices::pdf(file, width = width, height = height)
    on.exit(try(grDevices::dev.off(), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE)
    force(expr)
  }
}

# Read & prep
df <- readr::read_csv(input_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    year                    = as.integer(year),
    pct_FR_among_category   = as.numeric(pct_FR_among_category),
    category                = factor(category, levels = c("Left","Moderate","Right"))
  )

# Use whichever country label column exists
country_col <- intersect(c("country", "country_label"), names(df))[1]
if (is.na(country_col)) stop("CSV must have 'country' or 'country_label' column.")

# Color mapping: Left=blue, Moderate=green, Right=red
cat_cols <- c(Left = "#1f77b4", Moderate = "#2ca02c", Right = "#d62728")

plot_country <- function(cty_code, data){
  d <- data %>% filter(.data[[country_col]] == cty_code) %>% arrange(year, category)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(ggplot() + theme_void())

  ggplot(d, aes(x = year, y = pct_FR_among_category, color = category, group = category)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.05, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(size = 1.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cat_cols, breaks = c("Left","Moderate","Right")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Far-right vote share within E035 groups: ", cty_code),
      subtitle = "Left (≤2.5) • Moderate (2.5–7.5) • Right (≥7.5)",
      x = "Year", y = "% FR among category", color = "E035 category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

# Output PDF (multi-page: one per country)
out_file <- "out/plots/NATIONAL_egalitarian_FR_by_category.pdf"
make_pdf(out_file, expr = {
  walk(sort(unique(df[[country_col]])), ~ print(plot_country(.x, df)))
})

message("Wrote: ", out_file)

```

```{r}
##### Libraries ---------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(haven)
  library(readr)
  library(countrycode)
})

##### ---- Paths (EDIT these) -------------------------------------------------
ivs_path          <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/Integrated_values_surveys_1981-2022.dta"
fr_csv_path       <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/illibpopculsup_parties.csv"
populist_csv_path <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/populist.csv"
out_dir           <- "out/csv"

##### ---- Helpers ------------------------------------------------------------
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
neg_codes <- -5:-1

extract_year <- function(x){
  if (is.numeric(x)) { y <- floor(x); y %% 10000 } else {
    first <- stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d{4}"); suppressWarnings(as.integer(first))
  }
}

normalize_s009 <- function(x){
  y <- as.character(x)
  y[y %in% c("GB-GBN","UK")] <- "GB"
  y
}

to_num <- function(x) as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(x))

first_non_na <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (length(x)) x[[1]] else NA }

clean_general <- function(x) {
  xi <- to_num(x)
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi <= 0] <- NA_real_
  xi
}

clean_g006 <- function(x) {
  xi <- clean_general(x)
  xi[xi >= 5] <- NA_real_   # per request
  xi
}

# Clean ONE X047 column (EVS or WVS)
clean_x047_col <- function(x) {
  xi <- to_num(x)
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi == -4] <- NA_real_   # explicit missing code
  xi[xi <= 0] <- NA_real_
  xi[!(xi >= 1 & xi <= 10)] <- NA_real_
  xi
}

safe_mean <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
safe_prop <- function(x) {
  y <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(y)) NA_real_ else mean(y)
}

pick_first <- function(nms, pats) {
  hit <- unlist(lapply(pats, function(p) grep(p, nms, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)))
  if (length(hit)) nms[hit[1]] else NA_character_
}

##### ---- Load minimally needed columns (incl. party vars) -------------------
needed_cols <- c(
  "S009","S025","E033",
  "C002","C006","G006","F115","E114","D059",
  "X047_EVS","X047_WVS","X047WVS",
  # common party-id columns across IVS/WVS/EVS builds
  "E179_WVS","E179WVS","E179",  # WVS variants
  "E181A",                      # EVS variant
  "X051"                        # used in other chunks if needed
)

ivs <- haven::read_dta(ivs_path, col_select = tidyselect::any_of(needed_cols))

# Standardize possible alternative names
if ("X047WVS" %in% names(ivs) && !("X047_WVS" %in% names(ivs))) {
  ivs <- dplyr::rename(ivs, X047_WVS = X047WVS)
}
if ("E179WVS" %in% names(ivs) && !("E179_WVS" %in% names(ivs))) {
  ivs <- dplyr::rename(ivs, E179_WVS = E179WVS)
}

##### ---- Respondent party ID + source (rowwise choose WVS then EVS) ---------
wvs_party_raw <- clean_general(ivs$E179_WVS %||% ivs$E179 %||% NA_real_)
evs_party_raw <- clean_general(ivs$E181A      %||% NA_real_)

resp_party_id <- dplyr::coalesce(wvs_party_raw, evs_party_raw)
party_source  <- dplyr::case_when(
  !is.na(wvs_party_raw) ~ "WVS",
  !is.na(evs_party_raw) ~ "EVS",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

##### ---- Far-right party IDs from TWO sources (no double-counting) ----------
# (A) illibpopculsup_parties.csv → wvs_id / evs_id (flexible column names)
fr_raw_A <- readr::read_csv(fr_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename_with(tolower)
wvs_col_A  <- pick_first(names(fr_raw_A), c("^wvs[_ ]?id$", "^wvsid$"))
evs_col_A  <- pick_first(names(fr_raw_A), c("^evs[_ ]?id$", "^evsid$"))
name_col_A <- pick_first(names(fr_raw_A), c("^party(_name)?$", "^name$"))

fr_ids_A <- fr_raw_A %>%
  transmute(
    wvs_id     = if (!is.na(wvs_col_A)) as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[[wvs_col_A]]))) else NA_integer_,
    evs_id     = if (!is.na(evs_col_A)) as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[[evs_col_A]]))) else NA_integer_,
    party_name = if (!is.na(name_col_A)) as.character(.data[[name_col_A]]) else NA_character_
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wvs_id) | !is.na(evs_id)) %>%
  distinct()

fr_wvs_A <- fr_ids_A %>% filter(!is.na(wvs_id)) %>% pull(wvs_id) %>% unique()
fr_evs_A <- fr_ids_A %>% filter(!is.na(evs_id)) %>% pull(evs_id) %>% unique()

# (B) populist.csv → party_id (+ optional id_type/domain)
fr_raw_B <- readr::read_csv(populist_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename_with(tolower)
if (!"party_id" %in% names(fr_raw_B)) stop("populist.csv must contain a 'party_id' column.")
idtype_col_B <- pick_first(names(fr_raw_B), c("^id[_-]?type$", "^domain$", "^scheme$", "^source$"))

pop_ids <- fr_raw_B %>%
  transmute(party_id = as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[["party_id"]])))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(party_id)) %>%
  distinct() %>% pull(party_id)

# universes observed in the IVS (after cleaning)
univ_wvs <- sort(unique(na.omit(wvs_party_raw)))
univ_evs <- sort(unique(na.omit(evs_party_raw)))

if (!is.na(idtype_col_B)) {
  decl <- fr_raw_B %>%
    transmute(
      party_id = as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[["party_id"]]))),
      id_type  = tolower(as.character(.data[[idtype_col_B]]))
    ) %>% filter(!is.na(party_id))
  fr_wvs_B <- decl %>% filter(str_detect(id_type, "wvs")) %>% pull(party_id)
  fr_evs_B <- decl %>% filter(str_detect(id_type, "evs")) %>% pull(party_id)
} else {
  # Auto-map by overlap with observed universes
  fr_wvs_B <- intersect(pop_ids, univ_wvs)
  fr_evs_B <- intersect(pop_ids, univ_evs)
}

# Final de-duplicated FR sets
fr_wvs_ids <- sort(unique(union(fr_wvs_A, fr_wvs_B)))
fr_evs_ids <- sort(unique(union(fr_evs_A, fr_evs_B)))

##### ---- Tag FR voters (logical) --------------------------------------------
far_right_vote <- case_when(
  party_source == "EVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_evs_ids ~ TRUE,
  party_source == "WVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_wvs_ids ~ TRUE,
  party_source %in% c("EVS","WVS") & !is.na(resp_party_id) ~ FALSE,
  TRUE ~ NA
)

##### ---- Decide X047 source by country-year ---------------------------------
# Rule: if all EVS values in a country-year are -4 (or NA), use WVS; otherwise use EVS.
x047_evs_raw <- to_num(ivs$X047_EVS %||% NA_real_)
x047_wvs_raw <- to_num(ivs$X047_WVS %||% NA_real_)

src_tbl <- tibble(
  S009_code = normalize_s009(ivs$S009),
  year      = extract_year(ivs$S025),
  EVS_all_missing = is.na(x047_evs_raw) | x047_evs_raw == -4,
  WVS_all_missing = is.na(x047_wvs_raw) | x047_wvs_raw == -4
) %>%
  group_by(S009_code, year) %>%
  summarise(
    all_evs_miss = all(EVS_all_missing),
    all_wvs_miss = all(WVS_all_missing),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(X047_source = dplyr::case_when(
    all_evs_miss & !all_wvs_miss ~ "WVS",
    all_wvs_miss & !all_evs_miss ~ "EVS",
    !all_evs_miss & !all_wvs_miss ~ "EVS",  # prefer EVS when both available
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

##### ---- Minimal micro base + cleaning --------------------------------------
base <- ivs %>%
  transmute(
    S009_code     = normalize_s009(S009),
    year          = extract_year(S025),
    country_label = countrycode(S009_code, "iso2c", "country.name"),
    E033_num      = clean_general(E033),  # ideology; apply NA rules

    # Cleaned outcomes (NA rules applied)
    C002 = if ("C002" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(C002) else NA_real_,
    C006 = if ("C006" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(C006) else NA_real_,
    G006 = if ("G006" %in% names(ivs)) clean_g006(G006)   else NA_real_,
    F115 = if ("F115" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(F115) else NA_real_,
    E114 = if ("E114" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(E114) else NA_real_,
    D059 = if ("D059" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(D059) else NA_real_,

    # Both raw X047 columns for rowwise selection
    X047_EVS_clean = clean_x047_col(ivs$X047_EVS %||% NA_real_),
    X047_WVS_clean = clean_x047_col(ivs$X047_WVS %||% NA_real_),

    # Far-right indicator we just computed
    far_right_vote = far_right_vote
  ) %>%
  # Add source decision and pick the appropriate X047 per country-year
  left_join(src_tbl, by = c("S009_code","year")) %>%
  mutate(
    X047 = dplyr::case_when(
      X047_source == "EVS" ~ X047_EVS_clean,
      X047_source == "WVS" ~ X047_WVS_clean,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Ideology groups (overlaps by design at 5/6 boundaries per spec)
    is_center_left   = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 2.5 & E033_num <= 5,
    is_tight_mod     = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 4   & E033_num <= 6,
    is_center_right  = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >  5   & E033_num <= 7.5
  )

vars_to_mean <- intersect(c("C002","C006","G006","F115","E114","D059","X047"), names(base))

##### ---- Summariser (adds means + % far-right) ------------------------------
summarise_group_means <- function(df, group_flag, group_label, vars_to_mean){
  df %>%
    filter({{ group_flag }}) %>%
    group_by(S009_code, country_label, year) %>%
    summarise(
      n_group          = dplyr::n(),
      income_source    = first_non_na(X047_source),
      across(all_of(vars_to_mean), safe_mean, .names = "mean_{.col}"),
      pct_far_right    = 100 * safe_prop(far_right_vote),  # share among group
      n_far_right_obs  = sum(!is.na(far_right_vote)),
      n_far_right_yes  = sum(far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(country_label, year) %>%
    mutate(group = group_label) %>%
    select(group, country_label, S009_code, year, income_source,
           n_group, pct_far_right, n_far_right_yes, n_far_right_obs, everything())
}

##### ---- Country–year means for each group ----------------------------------
cl_means <- summarise_group_means(
  base, group_flag = is_center_left,  group_label = "Center-left (2.5–5)",
  vars_to_mean = vars_to_mean
)

tm_means <- summarise_group_means(
  base, group_flag = is_tight_mod,    group_label = "Tight moderates (4–6)",
  vars_to_mean = vars_to_mean
)

cr_means <- summarise_group_means(
  base, group_flag = is_center_right, group_label = "Center-right (5–7.5]",
  vars_to_mean = vars_to_mean
)

##### ---- Write outputs -------------------------------------------------------
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(cl_means, file.path(out_dir, "country_year_means_center_left.csv"))
readr::write_csv(tm_means, file.path(out_dir, "country_year_means_tight_moderates.csv"))
readr::write_csv(cr_means, file.path(out_dir, "country_year_means_center_right.csv"))

message("Wrote CSVs to: ", normalizePath(out_dir))
```

```{r}
##### ---- Dominant-group framework (X051 preferred; proxy only if missing) ----
# Choose scope for the X051 modal map when you need it for labels in summaries
dominance_scope <- "country"  # or "yearly"

# Optional manual overrides for X051 modal label (edit or leave empty)
# For country-scope, use cols: S009_code, dominant_label
# For yearly-scope, add 'year' as well and match on (S009_code, year)
dominant_overrides <- tibble::tibble(
  S009_code = c("GB","US"),
  dominant_label = c("White","White")
) %>% mutate(S009_code = normalize_s009(S009_code))

# ---- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
get_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(hit)) df[[hit[1]]] else NULL
}
norm_iso2 <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v)) return(rep(NA_character_, nrow(ivs)))
  y <- as.character(haven::as_factor(v))
  y <- toupper(y)
  y[y %in% c("", "NA", "NULL")] <- NA_character_
  y[y %in% c("UK","GB-GBN")] <- "GB"
  y[!grepl("^[A-Z]{2}$", y)] <- NA_character_
  y
}
is_yes1 <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v)) return(rep(NA, nrow(ivs)))
  neg_local <- c(-1L,-2L,-3L,-4L,-5L)
  x <- as.integer(haven::zap_labels(v))
  x[x %in% neg_local] <- NA_integer_
  x == 1L
}
choose_modal <- function(x){
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(x)) NA_character_ else names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

# ---- immigrant-background proxy (used ONLY if X051 unavailable per row) ----
# supports both naming schemes:
#   respondent: X002_02 OR v228b
#   father:     V001    OR v231b (+ optional v230 flag)
#   mother:     V002    OR v233b (+ optional v232 flag)
resp_birth <- norm_iso2(get_col(ivs, c("X002_02","v228b")))
dad_birth  <- norm_iso2(get_col(ivs, c("V001","v231b")))
mom_birth  <- norm_iso2(get_col(ivs, c("V002","v233b")))
dad_flag   <- is_yes1(get_col(ivs, c("v230")))
mom_flag   <- is_yes1(get_col(ivs, c("v232")))

survey_iso2 <- normalize_s009(ivs$S009)

resp_native <- ifelse(!is.na(resp_birth), resp_birth == survey_iso2, NA)
dad_native  <- dplyr::coalesce(dad_flag, ifelse(!is.na(dad_birth), dad_birth == survey_iso2, NA))
mom_native  <- dplyr::coalesce(mom_flag, ifelse(!is.na(mom_birth), mom_birth == survey_iso2, NA))

majority_native3 <- resp_native & dad_native & mom_native
minority_gen <- dplyr::case_when(
  majority_native3 %in% TRUE ~ 0L,   # majority (native ancestry)
  resp_native %in% TRUE      ~ 1L,   # 2nd gen minority
  resp_native %in% FALSE     ~ 2L,   # 1st gen minority
  TRUE                       ~ NA_integer_
)

imm_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  S009_code = survey_iso2,
  year      = extract_year(ivs$S025),
  majority_native3 = majority_native3,
  minority_gen     = minority_gen
)

# ---- X051 modal-label map (for labeling/joins; per-row X051 used directly) --
x051_label_fac <- if ("X051" %in% names(ivs)) haven::as_factor(ivs$X051) else factor(NA)
x051_label_chr_vec <- if ("X051" %in% names(ivs)) as.character(x051_label_fac) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(ivs))

x051_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  S009_code = normalize_s009(ivs$S009),
  year      = extract_year(ivs$S025),
  X051_lab  = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(x051_label_fac, level = NA)
)

dom_map <- if (dominance_scope == "yearly") {
  x051_tbl %>% dplyr::group_by(S009_code, year) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dominant_label = choose_modal(X051_lab), .groups = "drop")
} else {
  x051_tbl %>% dplyr::group_by(S009_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dominant_label = choose_modal(X051_lab), .groups = "drop")
}

# Apply overrides (schema must match the chosen scope) & ensure uniqueness
if (nrow(dominant_overrides)) {
  if (dominance_scope == "yearly" && "year" %in% names(dominant_overrides)) {
    dom_map <- dom_map %>%
      dplyr::anti_join(dominant_overrides, by = c("S009_code","year")) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(dominant_overrides %>% dplyr::select(S009_code, year, dominant_label))
  } else {
    dom_map <- dom_map %>%
      dplyr::anti_join(dominant_overrides, by = c("S009_code")) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(dominant_overrides %>% dplyr::select(S009_code, dominant_label))
  }
}
dom_map <- if (dominance_scope == "yearly") {
  dplyr::distinct(dom_map, S009_code, year, .keep_all = TRUE)
} else {
  dplyr::distinct(dom_map, S009_code, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# --- row-align safety: base and imm_tbl were both built directly from `ivs`
stopifnot(nrow(base) == nrow(ivs), nrow(imm_tbl) == nrow(ivs))

# Attach proxy columns row-wise (no big joins)
imm_cols <- imm_tbl %>% dplyr::select(majority_native3, minority_gen)

base_domflags <- base %>%
  dplyr::bind_cols(imm_cols) %>%  # row-wise attach; no cartesian joins
  {
    if (dominance_scope == "yearly") {
      dplyr::left_join(., dom_map, by = c("S009_code","year"))
    } else {
      dplyr::left_join(., dom_map, by = "S009_code")
    }
  } %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x051_label_chr   = x051_label_chr_vec,
    has_x051         = !is.na(x051_label_chr) & !is.na(dominant_label),
    is_dominant_x051 = has_x051 & (x051_label_chr == dominant_label),
    # Use X051 when present for this respondent; otherwise use the proxy
    is_dominant = dplyr::case_when(
      has_x051                          ~ is_dominant_x051,
      !has_x051 & !is.na(majority_native3) ~ majority_native3,
      TRUE                              ~ NA
    ),
    dominant_source = dplyr::case_when(
      has_x051                          ~ "X051",
      !has_x051 & !is.na(majority_native3) ~ "immigrant-proxy",
      TRUE                              ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Dominant-only slice for downstream use
base_dom <- base_domflags %>% dplyr::filter(is_dominant %in% TRUE)

##### ---- Dominant-only summaries & outputs ----------------------------------
# Reuse your summariser and add the dominant label for reference
summarise_group_means_dom <- function(df, group_flag, group_label, vars_to_mean){
  out <- summarise_group_means(
    df = df, group_flag = {{ group_flag }},
    group_label = paste0(group_label, " — dominant group only"),
    vars_to_mean = vars_to_mean
  )
  if (dominance_scope == "yearly") {
    out <- dplyr::left_join(out, dom_map, by = c("S009_code","year"))
  } else {
    out <- dplyr::left_join(out, dom_map, by = "S009_code")
  }
  dplyr::relocate(out, dominant_label, .after = country_label)
}

# If you previously filtered countries by a threshold, that can drop rows.
# It’s commented out here to avoid “missing countries”.
# tmp_tm <- summarise_group_means_dom(base_dom, is_tight_mod, "Tight moderates (4–6)", vars_to_mean)
# countries_to_keep <- tmp_tm %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(pct_far_right) & pct_far_right > 5) %>%
#   dplyr::distinct(S009_code) %>% dplyr::pull(S009_code)
# base_dom <- base_dom %>% dplyr::filter(S009_code %in% countries_to_keep)

# Dominant-only outputs
cl_means_dom <- summarise_group_means_dom(base_dom, is_center_left,  "Center-left (2.5–5)", vars_to_mean)
tm_means_dom <- summarise_group_means_dom(base_dom, is_tight_mod,    "Tight moderates (4–6)", vars_to_mean)
cr_means_dom <- summarise_group_means_dom(base_dom, is_center_right, "Center-right (5–7.5]", vars_to_mean)

out_dir_dom <- "out/csv_dominant_group"
dir.create(out_dir_dom, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(cl_means_dom, file.path(out_dir_dom, "country_year_means_center_left_dominant.csv"))
readr::write_csv(tm_means_dom, file.path(out_dir_dom, "country_year_means_tight_moderates_dominant.csv"))
readr::write_csv(cr_means_dom, file.path(out_dir_dom, "country_year_means_center_right_dominant.csv"))
message("Wrote dominant-group CSVs to: ", normalizePath(out_dir_dom))

```

```{r}
##### Libraries ---------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(haven)
  library(readr)
  library(countrycode)
})

##### ---- Paths (EDIT these) -------------------------------------------------
ivs_path          <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/Integrated_values_surveys_1981-2022.dta"
fr_csv_path       <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/illibpopculsup_parties.csv"
populist_csv_path <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/populist.csv"
out_dir           <- "out/csv"

##### ---- Helpers ------------------------------------------------------------
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
neg_codes <- -5:-1

extract_year <- function(x){
  if (is.numeric(x)) { y <- floor(x); y %% 10000 } else {
    first <- stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d{4}"); suppressWarnings(as.integer(first))
  }
}

normalize_s009 <- function(x){
  y <- as.character(x)
  y[y %in% c("GB-GBN","UK")] <- "GB"
  y
}

to_num <- function(x) as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(x))

first_non_na <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (length(x)) x[[1]] else NA }

clean_general <- function(x) {
  xi <- to_num(x)
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi <= 0] <- NA_real_
  xi
}

clean_g006 <- function(x) {
  xi <- clean_general(x)
  xi[xi >= 5] <- NA_real_   # per spec
  xi
}

# Clean ONE X047 column (EVS or WVS)
clean_x047_col <- function(x) {
  xi <- to_num(x)
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi == -4] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi <= 0] <- NA_real_
  xi[!(xi >= 1 & xi <= 10)] <- NA_real_
  xi
}

safe_mean <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
safe_prop <- function(x) {
  y <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(y)) NA_real_ else mean(y)
}

pick_first <- function(nms, pats) {
  hit <- unlist(lapply(pats, function(p) grep(p, nms, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)))
  if (length(hit)) nms[hit[1]] else NA_character_
}

##### ---- Load minimally needed columns (incl. proxy & party vars) -----------
needed_cols <- c(
  "S009","S025","E033",
  "C002","C006","G006","F115","E114","D059",
  "X047_EVS","X047_WVS","X047WVS",
  # party id variants
  "E179_WVS","E179WVS","E179",  # WVS
  "E181A",                      # EVS
  "X051",                       # Dominant-group label (if asked)
  # >>> NEW: immigrant-proxy variables (both naming schemes)
  "X002_02","v228b",            # respondent birth country (ISO-2)
  "V001","v231b","v230",        # father birth (ISO-2) + born-in-country flag
  "V002","v233b","v232"         # mother birth (ISO-2) + born-in-country flag
)

ivs <- haven::read_dta(ivs_path, col_select = tidyselect::any_of(needed_cols))

# Standardize possible alternative names
if ("X047WVS" %in% names(ivs) && !("X047_WVS" %in% names(ivs))) {
  ivs <- dplyr::rename(ivs, X047_WVS = X047WVS)
}
if ("E179WVS" %in% names(ivs) && !("E179_WVS" %in% names(ivs))) {
  ivs <- dplyr::rename(ivs, E179_WVS = E179WVS)
}

##### ---- Respondent party ID + source (use vector coalescing) ---------------
wvs_party_raw <- dplyr::coalesce(
  clean_general(ivs$E179_WVS),
  clean_general(ivs$E179)
)
evs_party_raw <- clean_general(ivs$E181A)

resp_party_id <- dplyr::coalesce(wvs_party_raw, evs_party_raw)
party_source  <- dplyr::case_when(
  !is.na(wvs_party_raw) ~ "WVS",
  !is.na(evs_party_raw) ~ "EVS",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

##### ---- Far-right party IDs from TWO sources (no double-counting) ----------
# (A) illibpopculsup_parties.csv → wvs_id / evs_id (flexible column names)
fr_raw_A <- readr::read_csv(fr_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename_with(tolower)
wvs_col_A  <- pick_first(names(fr_raw_A), c("^wvs[_ ]?id$", "^wvsid$"))
evs_col_A  <- pick_first(names(fr_raw_A), c("^evs[_ ]?id$", "^evsid$"))
name_col_A <- pick_first(names(fr_raw_A), c("^party(_name)?$", "^name$"))

fr_ids_A <- fr_raw_A %>%
  transmute(
    wvs_id     = if (!is.na(wvs_col_A)) as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[[wvs_col_A]]))) else NA_integer_,
    evs_id     = if (!is.na(evs_col_A)) as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[[evs_col_A]]))) else NA_integer_,
    party_name = if (!is.na(name_col_A)) as.character(.data[[name_col_A]]) else NA_character_
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wvs_id) | !is.na(evs_id)) %>%
  distinct()

fr_wvs_A <- fr_ids_A %>% filter(!is.na(wvs_id)) %>% pull(wvs_id) %>% unique()
fr_evs_A <- fr_ids_A %>% filter(!is.na(evs_id)) %>% pull(evs_id) %>% unique()

# (B) populist.csv → party_id (+ optional id_type/domain)
fr_raw_B <- readr::read_csv(populist_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename_with(tolower)
if (!"party_id" %in% names(fr_raw_B)) stop("populist.csv must contain a 'party_id' column.")
idtype_col_B <- pick_first(names(fr_raw_B), c("^id[_-]?type$", "^domain$", "^scheme$", "^source$"))

pop_ids <- fr_raw_B %>%
  transmute(party_id = as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[["party_id"]])))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(party_id)) %>%
  distinct() %>% pull(party_id)

# universes observed in the IVS (after cleaning)
univ_wvs <- sort(unique(na.omit(wvs_party_raw)))
univ_evs <- sort(unique(na.omit(evs_party_raw)))

if (!is.na(idtype_col_B)) {
  decl <- fr_raw_B %>%
    transmute(
      party_id = as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[["party_id"]]))),
      id_type  = tolower(as.character(.data[[idtype_col_B]]))
    ) %>% filter(!is.na(party_id))
  fr_wvs_B <- decl %>% filter(str_detect(id_type, "wvs")) %>% pull(party_id)
  fr_evs_B <- decl %>% filter(str_detect(id_type, "evs")) %>% pull(party_id)
} else {
  # Auto-map by overlap with observed universes
  fr_wvs_B <- intersect(pop_ids, univ_wvs)
  fr_evs_B <- intersect(pop_ids, univ_evs)
}

# Final de-duplicated FR sets
fr_wvs_ids <- sort(unique(union(fr_wvs_A, fr_wvs_B)))
fr_evs_ids <- sort(unique(union(fr_evs_A, fr_evs_B)))

##### ---- Tag FR voters (logical) --------------------------------------------
far_right_vote <- case_when(
  party_source == "EVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_evs_ids ~ TRUE,
  party_source == "WVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_wvs_ids ~ TRUE,
  party_source %in% c("EVS","WVS") & !is.na(resp_party_id) ~ FALSE,
  TRUE ~ NA
)

##### ---- Decide X047 source by country-year ---------------------------------
# Rule: if all EVS values in a country-year are -4 (or NA), use WVS; otherwise use EVS.
x047_evs_raw <- to_num(ivs$X047_EVS %||% NA_real_)
x047_wvs_raw <- to_num(ivs$X047_WVS %||% NA_real_)

src_tbl <- tibble(
  S009_code = normalize_s009(ivs$S009),
  year      = extract_year(ivs$S025),
  EVS_all_missing = is.na(x047_evs_raw) | x047_evs_raw == -4,
  WVS_all_missing = is.na(x047_wvs_raw) | x047_wvs_raw == -4
) %>%
  group_by(S009_code, year) %>%
  summarise(
    all_evs_miss = all(EVS_all_missing),
    all_wvs_miss = all(WVS_all_missing),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(X047_source = dplyr::case_when(
    all_evs_miss & !all_wvs_miss ~ "WVS",
    all_wvs_miss & !all_evs_miss ~ "EVS",
    !all_evs_miss & !all_wvs_miss ~ "EVS",  # prefer EVS when both available
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

##### ---- Minimal micro base + cleaning --------------------------------------
base <- ivs %>%
  transmute(
    S009_code     = normalize_s009(S009),
    year          = extract_year(S025),
    country_label = countrycode(S009_code, "iso2c", "country.name"),
    E033_num      = clean_general(E033),

    # Cleaned outcomes (NA rules applied)
    C002 = if ("C002" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(C002) else NA_real_,
    C006 = if ("C006" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(C006) else NA_real_,
    G006 = if ("G006" %in% names(ivs)) clean_g006(G006)   else NA_real_,
    F115 = if ("F115" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(F115) else NA_real_,
    E114 = if ("E114" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(E114) else NA_real_,
    D059 = if ("D059" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(D059) else NA_real_,

    # Raw X047 columns for rowwise selection
    X047_EVS_clean = clean_x047_col(ivs$X047_EVS %||% NA_real_),
    X047_WVS_clean = clean_x047_col(ivs$X047_WVS %||% NA_real_),

    # Far-right indicator we just computed
    far_right_vote = far_right_vote
  ) %>%
  # Add source decision and pick the appropriate X047 per country-year
  left_join(src_tbl, by = c("S009_code","year")) %>%
  mutate(
    X047 = dplyr::case_when(
      X047_source == "EVS" ~ X047_EVS_clean,
      X047_source == "WVS" ~ X047_WVS_clean,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Ideology groups (overlaps at 5/6 per spec)
    is_center_left   = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 2.5 & E033_num <= 5,
    is_tight_mod     = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 4   & E033_num <= 6,
    is_center_right  = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >  5   & E033_num <= 7.5
  )

vars_to_mean <- intersect(c("C002","C006","G006","F115","E114","D059","X047"), names(base))

##### ---- Summariser (adds means + % far-right) ------------------------------
summarise_group_means <- function(df, group_flag, group_label, vars_to_mean){
  df %>%
    filter({{ group_flag }}) %>%
    group_by(S009_code, country_label, year) %>%
    summarise(
      n_group          = dplyr::n(),
      income_source    = first_non_na(X047_source),
      across(all_of(vars_to_mean), safe_mean, .names = "mean_{.col}"),
      pct_far_right    = 100 * safe_prop(far_right_vote),  # share among group
      n_far_right_obs  = sum(!is.na(far_right_vote)),
      n_far_right_yes  = sum(far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(country_label, year) %>%
    mutate(group = group_label) %>%
    select(group, country_label, S009_code, year, income_source,
           n_group, pct_far_right, n_far_right_yes, n_far_right_obs, everything())
}

##### ---- Country–year means for each group ----------------------------------
cl_means <- summarise_group_means(base, is_center_left,  "Center-left (2.5–5)", vars_to_mean)
tm_means <- summarise_group_means(base, is_tight_mod,    "Tight moderates (4–6)", vars_to_mean)
cr_means <- summarise_group_means(base, is_center_right, "Center-right (5–7.5]", vars_to_mean)

##### ---- Write non-dominant outputs -----------------------------------------
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(cl_means, file.path(out_dir, "country_year_means_center_left.csv"))
readr::write_csv(tm_means, file.path(out_dir, "country_year_means_tight_moderates.csv"))
readr::write_csv(cr_means, file.path(out_dir, "country_year_means_center_right.csv"))

message("Wrote CSVs to: ", normalizePath(out_dir))

```

```{r}
##### ---- Dominant-group framework (X051 preferred; proxy only if missing) ----
# Choose scope for the X051 modal map when you need it for labels in summaries
dominance_scope <- "country"  # or "yearly"

# Optional manual overrides for X051 modal label (edit or leave empty)
# For country-scope, use cols: S009_code, dominant_label
# For yearly-scope, add 'year' as well and match on (S009_code, year)
dominant_overrides <- tibble::tibble(
  S009_code = c("GB","US"),
  dominant_label = c("White","White")
) %>% mutate(S009_code = normalize_s009(S009_code))

# ---- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
get_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(hit)) df[[hit[1]]] else NULL
}
norm_iso2 <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v)) return(rep(NA_character_, nrow(ivs)))
  y <- as.character(haven::as_factor(v))
  y <- toupper(y)
  y[y %in% c("", "NA", "NULL")] <- NA_character_
  y[y %in% c("UK","GB-GBN")] <- "GB"
  y[!grepl("^[A-Z]{2}$", y)] <- NA_character_
  y
}
is_yes1 <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v)) return(rep(NA, nrow(ivs)))
  neg_local <- c(-1L,-2L,-3L,-4L,-5L)
  x <- as.integer(haven::zap_labels(v))
  x[x %in% neg_local] <- NA_integer_
  x == 1L
}
choose_modal <- function(x){
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(x)) NA_character_ else names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

# ---- immigrant-background proxy (used ONLY if X051 unavailable per row) ----
# supports both naming schemes:
#   respondent: X002_02 OR v228b
#   father:     V001    OR v231b (+ optional v230 flag)
#   mother:     V002    OR v233b (+ optional v232 flag)
resp_birth <- norm_iso2(get_col(ivs, c("X002_02","v228b")))
dad_birth  <- norm_iso2(get_col(ivs, c("V001","v231b")))
mom_birth  <- norm_iso2(get_col(ivs, c("V002","v233b")))
dad_flag   <- is_yes1(get_col(ivs, c("v230")))
mom_flag   <- is_yes1(get_col(ivs, c("v232")))

survey_iso2 <- normalize_s009(ivs$S009)

resp_native <- ifelse(!is.na(resp_birth), resp_birth == survey_iso2, NA)
dad_native  <- dplyr::coalesce(dad_flag, ifelse(!is.na(dad_birth), dad_birth == survey_iso2, NA))
mom_native  <- dplyr::coalesce(mom_flag, ifelse(!is.na(mom_birth), mom_birth == survey_iso2, NA))

majority_native3 <- resp_native & dad_native & mom_native
minority_gen <- dplyr::case_when(
  majority_native3 %in% TRUE ~ 0L,   # majority (native ancestry)
  resp_native %in% TRUE      ~ 1L,   # 2nd gen minority
  resp_native %in% FALSE     ~ 2L,   # 1st gen minority
  TRUE                       ~ NA_integer_
)

imm_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  S009_code = survey_iso2,
  year      = extract_year(ivs$S025),
  majority_native3 = majority_native3,
  minority_gen     = minority_gen
)

# ---- X051 modal-label map (for labeling/joins; per-row X051 used directly) --
x051_label_fac <- if ("X051" %in% names(ivs)) haven::as_factor(ivs$X051) else factor(NA)
x051_label_chr_vec <- if ("X051" %in% names(ivs)) as.character(x051_label_fac) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(ivs))

x051_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  S009_code = normalize_s009(ivs$S009),
  year      = extract_year(ivs$S025),
  X051_lab  = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(x051_label_fac, level = "(Missing)")
)

dom_map <- if (dominance_scope == "yearly") {
  x051_tbl %>% dplyr::group_by(S009_code, year) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dominant_label = choose_modal(X051_lab), .groups = "drop")
} else {
  x051_tbl %>% dplyr::group_by(S009_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dominant_label = choose_modal(X051_lab), .groups = "drop")
}

# Apply overrides (schema must match the chosen scope) & ensure uniqueness
if (nrow(dominant_overrides)) {
  if (dominance_scope == "yearly" && "year" %in% names(dominant_overrides)) {
    dom_map <- dom_map %>%
      dplyr::anti_join(dominant_overrides, by = c("S009_code","year")) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(dominant_overrides %>% dplyr::select(S009_code, year, dominant_label))
  } else {
    dom_map <- dom_map %>%
      dplyr::anti_join(dominant_overrides, by = c("S009_code")) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(dominant_overrides %>% dplyr::select(S009_code, dominant_label))
  }
}
dom_map <- if (dominance_scope == "yearly") {
  dplyr::distinct(dom_map, S009_code, year, .keep_all = TRUE)
} else {
  dplyr::distinct(dom_map, S009_code, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# --- row-align safety: base and imm_tbl were both built from `ivs`
stopifnot(nrow(base) == nrow(ivs), nrow(imm_tbl) == nrow(ivs))

# Attach proxy columns row-wise (no big joins)
imm_cols <- imm_tbl %>% dplyr::select(majority_native3, minority_gen)

base_domflags <- base %>%
  dplyr::bind_cols(imm_cols) %>%  # row-wise; avoids cartesian joins
  {
    if (dominance_scope == "yearly") {
      dplyr::left_join(., dom_map, by = c("S009_code","year"))
    } else {
      dplyr::left_join(., dom_map, by = "S009_code")
    }
  } %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x051_label_chr   = x051_label_chr_vec,
    has_x051         = !is.na(x051_label_chr) & !is.na(dominant_label),
    is_dominant_x051 = has_x051 & (x051_label_chr == dominant_label),
    # Use X051 when present for this respondent; otherwise use the proxy
    is_dominant = dplyr::case_when(
      has_x051                             ~ is_dominant_x051,
      !has_x051 & !is.na(majority_native3) ~ majority_native3,
      TRUE                                 ~ NA
    ),
    dominant_source = dplyr::case_when(
      has_x051                             ~ "X051",
      !has_x051 & !is.na(majority_native3) ~ "immigrant-proxy",
      TRUE                                 ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Give proxy rows a label so 'dominant_label' isn't blank when X051 is absent
    dominant_label = ifelse(
      is.na(dominant_label) & dominant_source == "immigrant-proxy",
      "native ancestry (proxy)",  # edit if you want a different string
      dominant_label
    )
  )

# Keep all rows in base_domflags; only slice for dominant-only exports:
base_dom <- base_domflags %>% dplyr::filter(is_dominant %in% TRUE)

##### ---- Dominant-only summaries & outputs ----------------------------------
summarise_group_means_dom <- function(df, group_flag, group_label, vars_to_mean){
  out <- summarise_group_means(
    df = df, group_flag = {{ group_flag }},
    group_label = paste0(group_label, " — dominant group only"),
    vars_to_mean = vars_to_mean
  )
  if (dominance_scope == "yearly") {
    out <- dplyr::left_join(out, dom_map, by = c("S009_code","year"))
  } else {
    out <- dplyr::left_join(out, dom_map, by = "S009_code")
  }
  dplyr::relocate(out, dominant_label, .after = country_label)
}

# If you previously filtered by a threshold, that drops countries.
# Leave commented unless you really want it.
# tmp_tm <- summarise_group_means_dom(base_dom, is_tight_mod, "Tight moderates (4–6)", vars_to_mean)
# countries_to_keep <- tmp_tm %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(pct_far_right) & pct_far_right > 5) %>%
#   dplyr::distinct(S009_code) %>% dplyr::pull(S009_code)
# base_dom <- base_dom %>% dplyr::filter(S009_code %in% countries_to_keep)

# Dominant-only outputs
cl_means_dom <- summarise_group_means_dom(base_dom, is_center_left,  "Center-left (2.5–5)", vars_to_mean)
tm_means_dom <- summarise_group_means_dom(base_dom, is_tight_mod,    "Tight moderates (4–6)", vars_to_mean)
cr_means_dom <- summarise_group_means_dom(base_dom, is_center_right, "Center-right (5–7.5]", vars_to_mean)

out_dir_dom <- "out/csv_dominant_group"
dir.create(out_dir_dom, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(cl_means_dom, file.path(out_dir_dom, "country_year_means_center_left_dominant.csv"))
readr::write_csv(tm_means_dom, file.path(out_dir_dom, "country_year_means_tight_moderates_dominant.csv"))
readr::write_csv(cr_means_dom, file.path(out_dir_dom, "country_year_means_center_right_dominant.csv"))
message("Wrote dominant-group CSVs to: ", normalizePath(out_dir_dom))

```

```{r}
##### Libraries ---------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(haven)
  library(readr)
  library(countrycode)
})

##### ---- Paths (EDIT these) -------------------------------------------------
ivs_path       <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/Integrated_values_surveys_1981-2022.dta"
fr_codes_path  <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/far_right_party_codes.csv"
out_dir        <- "out/csv"

##### ---- Helpers ------------------------------------------------------------
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
neg_codes <- -5:-1

extract_year <- function(x){
  if (is.numeric(x)) { y <- floor(x); y %% 10000 } else {
    first <- stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d{4}"); suppressWarnings(as.integer(first))
  }
}

normalize_s009 <- function(x){
  y <- as.character(x)
  y[y %in% c("GB-GBN","UK")] <- "GB"
  y
}

to_num <- function(x) as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(x))
first_non_na <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (length(x)) x[[1]] else NA }

clean_general <- function(x) {
  xi <- to_num(x)
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi <= 0] <- NA_real_
  xi
}
clean_g006 <- function(x) { xi <- clean_general(x); xi[xi >= 5] <- NA_real_; xi }

# Clean ONE X047 column (EVS or WVS)
clean_x047_col <- function(x) {
  xi <- to_num(x)
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi == -4] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi <= 0] <- NA_real_
  xi[!(xi >= 1 & xi <= 10)] <- NA_real_
  xi
}

safe_mean <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
safe_prop <- function(x) { y <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (!length(y)) NA_real_ else mean(y) }

pick_first <- function(nms, pats) {
  hit <- unlist(lapply(pats, function(p) grep(p, nms, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)))
  if (length(hit)) nms[hit[1]] else NA_character_
}

##### ---- Load minimally needed columns (incl. proxy & party vars) -----------
needed_cols <- c(
  "S009","S025","E033",
  "C002","C006","G006","F115","E114","D059",
  "X047_EVS","X047_WVS","X047WVS",
  # party id variants
  "E179_WVS","E179WVS","E179",  # WVS
  "E181A",                      # EVS
  "X051",                       # Dominant-group label (if asked)
  # immigrant-proxy variables (both naming schemes)
  "X002_02","v228b",            # respondent birth country (ISO-2)
  "V001","v231b","v230",        # father birth (ISO-2) + born-in-country flag
  "V002","v233b","v232"         # mother birth (ISO-2) + born-in-country flag
)

ivs <- haven::read_dta(ivs_path, col_select = tidyselect::any_of(needed_cols))

# Standardize possible alternative names
if ("X047WVS" %in% names(ivs) && !("X047_WVS" %in% names(ivs))) {
  ivs <- dplyr::rename(ivs, X047_WVS = X047WVS)
}
if ("E179WVS" %in% names(ivs) && !("E179_WVS" %in% names(ivs))) {
  ivs <- dplyr::rename(ivs, E179_WVS = E179WVS)
}

##### ---- Respondent party ID + source (use vector coalescing) ---------------
wvs_party_raw <- dplyr::coalesce(
  clean_general(ivs$E179_WVS),
  clean_general(ivs$E179)
)
evs_party_raw <- clean_general(ivs$E181A)

resp_party_id <- dplyr::coalesce(wvs_party_raw, evs_party_raw)
party_source  <- dplyr::case_when(
  !is.na(wvs_party_raw) ~ "WVS",
  !is.na(evs_party_raw) ~ "EVS",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

##### ---- Far-right party IDs from far_right_party_codes.csv -----------------
# Long format expected: columns code_type (wvs_id/evs_id/party_id/party_id_2) and code
fr_codes <- readr::read_csv(fr_codes_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(tolower) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code_type = tolower(as.character(.data[["code_type"]])),
    code      = as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[["code"]])))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(code), code_type %in% c("wvs_id","evs_id","party_id","party_id_2")) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# Map to WVS/EVS universes.
# NOTE: generic party_id / party_id_2 are added to BOTH universes; change if you need stricter mapping.
fr_wvs_ids <- fr_codes %>% dplyr::filter(code_type %in% c("wvs_id","party_id","party_id_2")) %>% dplyr::pull(code) %>% unique()
fr_evs_ids <- fr_codes %>% dplyr::filter(code_type %in% c("evs_id","party_id","party_id_2")) %>% dplyr::pull(code) %>% unique()

##### ---- Tag FR voters (logical) --------------------------------------------
far_right_vote <- dplyr::case_when(
  party_source == "EVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_evs_ids ~ TRUE,
  party_source == "WVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_wvs_ids ~ TRUE,
  party_source %in% c("EVS","WVS") & !is.na(resp_party_id) ~ FALSE,
  TRUE ~ NA
)

##### ---- Decide X047 source by country-year ---------------------------------
x047_evs_raw <- to_num(ivs$X047_EVS %||% NA_real_)
x047_wvs_raw <- to_num(ivs$X047_WVS %||% NA_real_)

src_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  S009_code = normalize_s009(ivs$S009),
  year      = extract_year(ivs$S025),
  EVS_all_missing = is.na(x047_evs_raw) | x047_evs_raw == -4,
  WVS_all_missing = is.na(x047_wvs_raw) | x047_wvs_raw == -4
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(S009_code, year) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    all_evs_miss = all(EVS_all_missing),
    all_wvs_miss = all(WVS_all_missing),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(X047_source = dplyr::case_when(
    all_evs_miss & !all_wvs_miss ~ "WVS",
    all_wvs_miss & !all_evs_miss ~ "EVS",
    !all_evs_miss & !all_wvs_miss ~ "EVS",  # prefer EVS when both available
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

##### ---- Minimal micro base + cleaning --------------------------------------
base <- ivs %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    S009_code     = normalize_s009(S009),
    year          = extract_year(S025),
    country_label = countrycode(S009_code, "iso2c", "country.name"),
    E033_num      = clean_general(E033),

    # Cleaned outcomes (NA rules applied)
    C002 = if ("C002" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(C002) else NA_real_,
    C006 = if ("C006" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(C006) else NA_real_,
    G006 = if ("G006" %in% names(ivs)) clean_g006(G006)   else NA_real_,
    F115 = if ("F115" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(F115) else NA_real_,
    E114 = if ("E114" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(E114) else NA_real_,
    D059 = if ("D059" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(D059) else NA_real_,

    # Raw X047 columns for rowwise selection
    X047_EVS_clean = clean_x047_col(ivs$X047_EVS %||% NA_real_),
    X047_WVS_clean = clean_x047_col(ivs$X047_WVS %||% NA_real_),

    # Far-right indicator we just computed
    far_right_vote = far_right_vote
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(src_tbl, by = c("S009_code","year")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    X047 = dplyr::case_when(
      X047_source == "EVS" ~ X047_EVS_clean,
      X047_source == "WVS" ~ X047_WVS_clean,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Ideology groups (overlaps at 5/6 per spec)
    is_center_left   = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 2.5 & E033_num <= 5,
    is_tight_mod     = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 4   & E033_num <= 6,
    is_center_right  = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >  5   & E033_num <= 7.5
  )

vars_to_mean <- intersect(c("C002","C006","G006","F115","E114","D059","X047"), names(base))

##### ---- Summariser + country filter ----------------------------------------
summarise_group_means <- function(df, group_flag, group_label, vars_to_mean){
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter({{ group_flag }}) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(S009_code, country_label, year) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_group          = dplyr::n(),
      income_source    = first_non_na(X047_source),
      dplyr::across(all_of(vars_to_mean), safe_mean, .names = "mean_{.col}"),
      pct_far_right    = 100 * safe_prop(far_right_vote),
      n_far_right_obs  = sum(!is.na(far_right_vote)),
      n_far_right_yes  = sum(far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(country_label, year) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(group = group_label) %>%
    dplyr::select(group, country_label, S009_code, year, income_source,
                  n_group, pct_far_right, n_far_right_yes, n_far_right_obs, dplyr::everything())
}

filter_countries_by_fr <- function(df){
  keep <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(S009_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(any_fr = any(pct_far_right > 0, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(any_fr) %>% dplyr::pull(S009_code)
  df %>% dplyr::filter(S009_code %in% keep)
}

##### ---- Country–year means for each group ----------------------------------
cl_means <- summarise_group_means(base, is_center_left,  "Center-left (2.5–5)", vars_to_mean) %>% filter_countries_by_fr()
tm_means <- summarise_group_means(base, is_tight_mod,    "Tight moderates (4–6)", vars_to_mean) %>% filter_countries_by_fr()
cr_means <- summarise_group_means(base, is_center_right, "Center-right (5–7.5]", vars_to_mean) %>% filter_countries_by_fr()

##### ---- Write non-dominant outputs -----------------------------------------
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(cl_means, file.path(out_dir, "country_year_means_center_left.csv"))
readr::write_csv(tm_means, file.path(out_dir, "country_year_means_tight_moderates.csv"))
readr::write_csv(cr_means, file.path(out_dir, "country_year_means_center_right.csv"))

message("Wrote CSVs to: ", normalizePath(out_dir))
```

```{r}
##### ---- Dominant-group framework (X051 preferred; proxy only if missing) ----
# Choose scope for the X051 modal map when you need it for labels in summaries
dominance_scope <- "country"  # or "yearly"

# Optional manual overrides for X051 modal label
dominant_overrides <- tibble::tibble(
  S009_code = c("GB","US"),
  dominant_label = c("White","White")
) %>% dplyr::mutate(S009_code = normalize_s009(S009_code))

# ---- helpers (re-use) -------------------------------------------------------
get_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(hit)) df[[hit[1]]] else NULL
}
norm_iso2 <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v)) return(rep(NA_character_, nrow(ivs)))
  y <- as.character(haven::as_factor(v))
  y <- toupper(y)
  y[y %in% c("", "NA", "NULL")] <- NA_character_
  y[y %in% c("UK","GB-GBN")] <- "GB"
  y[!grepl("^[A-Z]{2}$", y)] <- NA_character_
  y
}
is_yes1 <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v)) return(rep(NA, nrow(ivs)))
  neg_local <- c(-1L,-2L,-3L,-4L,-5L)
  x <- as.integer(haven::zap_labels(v))
  x[x %in% neg_local] <- NA_integer_
  x == 1L
}
choose_modal <- function(x){
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(x)) NA_character_ else names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

# ---- immigrant-background proxy (used ONLY if X051 unavailable per row) ----
resp_birth <- norm_iso2(get_col(ivs, c("X002_02","v228b")))
dad_birth  <- norm_iso2(get_col(ivs, c("V001","v231b")))
mom_birth  <- norm_iso2(get_col(ivs, c("V002","v233b")))
dad_flag   <- is_yes1(get_col(ivs, c("v230")))
mom_flag   <- is_yes1(get_col(ivs, c("v232")))

survey_iso2 <- normalize_s009(ivs$S009)

resp_native <- ifelse(!is.na(resp_birth), resp_birth == survey_iso2, NA)
dad_native  <- dplyr::coalesce(dad_flag, ifelse(!is.na(dad_birth), dad_birth == survey_iso2, NA))
mom_native  <- dplyr::coalesce(mom_flag, ifelse(!is.na(mom_birth), mom_birth == survey_iso2, NA))

majority_native3 <- resp_native & dad_native & mom_native
minority_gen <- dplyr::case_when(
  majority_native3 %in% TRUE ~ 0L,   # majority (native ancestry)
  resp_native %in% TRUE      ~ 1L,   # 2nd gen minority
  resp_native %in% FALSE     ~ 2L,   # 1st gen minority
  TRUE                       ~ NA_integer_
)

imm_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  S009_code = survey_iso2,
  year      = extract_year(ivs$S025),
  majority_native3 = majority_native3,
  minority_gen     = minority_gen
)

# ---- X051 modal-label map (for labeling/joins; per-row X051 used directly) --
x051_label_fac <- if ("X051" %in% names(ivs)) haven::as_factor(ivs$X051) else factor(NA)
x051_label_chr_vec <- if ("X051" %in% names(ivs)) as.character(x051_label_fac) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(ivs))

x051_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  S009_code = normalize_s009(ivs$S009),
  year      = extract_year(ivs$S025),
  X051_lab  = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(x051_label_fac, level = "(Missing)")
)

dom_map <- if (dominance_scope == "yearly") {
  x051_tbl %>% dplyr::group_by(S009_code, year) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dominant_label = choose_modal(X051_lab), .groups = "drop")
} else {
  x051_tbl %>% dplyr::group_by(S009_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dominant_label = choose_modal(X051_lab), .groups = "drop")
}

# Apply overrides & ensure uniqueness
if (nrow(dominant_overrides)) {
  if (dominance_scope == "yearly" && "year" %in% names(dominant_overrides)) {
    dom_map <- dom_map %>%
      dplyr::anti_join(dominant_overrides, by = c("S009_code","year")) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(dominant_overrides %>% dplyr::select(S009_code, year, dominant_label))
  } else {
    dom_map <- dom_map %>%
      dplyr::anti_join(dominant_overrides, by = c("S009_code")) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(dominant_overrides %>% dplyr::select(S009_code, dominant_label))
  }
}
dom_map <- if (dominance_scope == "yearly") {
  dplyr::distinct(dom_map, S009_code, year, .keep_all = TRUE)
} else {
  dplyr::distinct(dom_map, S009_code, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# --- row-align safety --------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(nrow(base) == nrow(ivs), nrow(imm_tbl) == nrow(ivs))

# Attach proxy columns row-wise; join dom_map for labels
imm_cols <- imm_tbl %>% dplyr::select(majority_native3, minority_gen)

base_domflags <- base %>%
  dplyr::bind_cols(imm_cols) %>%  # row-wise; avoids cartesian joins
  {
    if (dominance_scope == "yearly") {
      dplyr::left_join(., dom_map, by = c("S009_code","year"))
    } else {
      dplyr::left_join(., dom_map, by = "S009_code")
    }
  } %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x051_label_chr   = x051_label_chr_vec,
    has_x051         = !is.na(x051_label_chr) & !is.na(dominant_label),
    is_dominant_x051 = has_x051 & (x051_label_chr == dominant_label),
    # Use X051 when present; otherwise use the proxy
    is_dominant = dplyr::case_when(
      has_x051                             ~ is_dominant_x051,
      !has_x051 & !is.na(majority_native3) ~ majority_native3,
      TRUE                                 ~ NA
    ),
    dominant_source = dplyr::case_when(
      has_x051                             ~ "X051",
      !has_x051 & !is.na(majority_native3) ~ "immigrant-proxy",
      TRUE                                 ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Give proxy rows a label so 'dominant_label' isn't blank when X051 is absent
    dominant_label = ifelse(
      is.na(dominant_label) & dominant_source == "immigrant-proxy",
      "native ancestry (proxy)",
      dominant_label
    )
  )

# Dominant-only slice for downstream summaries
base_dom <- base_domflags %>% dplyr::filter(is_dominant %in% TRUE)

##### ---- Dominant-only summaries & outputs ----------------------------------
summarise_group_means_dom <- function(df, group_flag, group_label, vars_to_mean){
  out <- summarise_group_means(
    df = df, group_flag = {{ group_flag }},
    group_label = paste0(group_label, " — dominant group only"),
    vars_to_mean = vars_to_mean
  )
  if (dominance_scope == "yearly") {
    out <- dplyr::left_join(out, dom_map, by = c("S009_code","year"))
  } else {
    out <- dplyr::left_join(out, dom_map, by = "S009_code")
  }
  dplyr::relocate(out, dominant_label, .after = country_label)
}

filter_countries_by_fr <- function(df){
  keep <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(S009_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(any_fr = any(pct_far_right > 0, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(any_fr) %>% dplyr::pull(S009_code)
  df %>% dplyr::filter(S009_code %in% keep)
}

# Dominant-only outputs (filtered to countries with any pct_far_right > 0)
cl_means_dom <- summarise_group_means_dom(base_dom, is_center_left,  "Center-left (2.5–5)", vars_to_mean) %>% filter_countries_by_fr()
tm_means_dom <- summarise_group_means_dom(base_dom, is_tight_mod,    "Tight moderates (4–6)", vars_to_mean) %>% filter_countries_by_fr()
cr_means_dom <- summarise_group_means_dom(base_dom, is_center_right, "Center-right (5–7.5]", vars_to_mean) %>% filter_countries_by_fr()

out_dir_dom <- "out/csv_dominant_group"
dir.create(out_dir_dom, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(cl_means_dom, file.path(out_dir_dom, "country_year_means_center_left_dominant.csv"))
readr::write_csv(tm_means_dom, file.path(out_dir_dom, "country_year_means_tight_moderates_dominant.csv"))
readr::write_csv(cr_means_dom, file.path(out_dir_dom, "country_year_means_center_right_dominant.csv"))
message("Wrote dominant-group CSVs to: ", normalizePath(out_dir_dom))

```

```{r}
##### Libraries ---------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(haven)
  library(readr)
  library(countrycode)
})

##### ---- Paths (EDIT these) -------------------------------------------------
ivs_path       <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/Integrated_values_surveys_1981-2022.dta"
fr_codes_path  <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/far_right_party_codes.csv"

out_dir_csv    <- "out/csv"
out_dir_plots  <- "out/plots"
dir.create(out_dir_csv,   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir_plots, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

##### ---- Helpers ------------------------------------------------------------
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
neg_codes <- -5:-1

extract_year <- function(x){
  if (is.numeric(x)) { y <- floor(x); y %% 10000 } else {
    first <- stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d{4}"); suppressWarnings(as.integer(first))
  }
}

normalize_s009 <- function(x){
  y <- as.character(x)
  y[y %in% c("GB-GBN","UK")] <- "GB"
  y
}

to_num <- function(x) as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(x))
first_non_na <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (length(x)) x[[1]] else NA }

clean_general <- function(x) {
  xi <- to_num(x)
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi <= 0] <- NA_real_
  xi
}
clean_1to4 <- function(x){
  xi <- to_num(x)
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_
  xi[!(xi >= 1 & xi <= 4)] <- NA_real_
  xi
}
clean_g006 <- clean_1to4

# Clean ONE X047 column (EVS or WVS)
clean_x047_col <- function(x) {
  xi <- to_num(x)
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi == -4] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi <= 0] <- NA_real_
  xi[!(xi >= 1 & xi <= 10)] <- NA_real_
  xi
}

safe_mean <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
safe_prop <- function(x) { y <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (!length(y)) NA_real_ else mean(y) }

pick_first <- function(nms, pats) {
  hit <- unlist(lapply(pats, function(p) grep(p, nms, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)))
  if (length(hit)) nms[hit[1]] else NA_character_
}

scale01 <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  r <- suppressWarnings(range(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!is.finite(r[1]) || !is.finite(r[2]) || r[1] == r[2]) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  (x - r[1]) / (r[2] - r[1])
}

##### ---- Load minimally needed columns (incl. proxy & party vars) -----------
needed_cols <- c(
  "S009","S025","E033",
  "C002","C006","G002","G006","E114","D059",   # <-- G002 added; F115 not used
  "X047_EVS","X047_WVS","X047WVS",
  "E179_WVS","E179WVS","E179",                 # WVS
  "E181A",                                     # EVS
  "X051",                                      # Dominant-group label (if asked)
  "X002_02","v228b","V001","v231b","v230","V002","v233b","v232" # immigrant-proxy
)

ivs <- haven::read_dta(ivs_path, col_select = tidyselect::any_of(needed_cols))

# Standardize possible alternative names
if ("X047WVS" %in% names(ivs) && !("X047_WVS" %in% names(ivs))) {
  ivs <- dplyr::rename(ivs, X047_WVS = X047WVS)
}
if ("E179WVS" %in% names(ivs) && !("E179_WVS" %in% names(ivs))) {
  ivs <- dplyr::rename(ivs, E179_WVS = E179WVS)
}

##### ---- Respondent party ID + source ---------------------------------------
wvs_party_raw <- dplyr::coalesce(
  clean_general(ivs$E179_WVS),
  clean_general(ivs$E179)
)
evs_party_raw <- clean_general(ivs$E181A)

resp_party_id <- dplyr::coalesce(wvs_party_raw, evs_party_raw)
party_source  <- dplyr::case_when(
  !is.na(wvs_party_raw) ~ "WVS",
  !is.na(evs_party_raw) ~ "EVS",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

##### ---- Far-right party IDs (long format: code_type, code) -----------------
fr_codes <- readr::read_csv(fr_codes_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(tolower) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code_type = tolower(as.character(.data[["code_type"]])),
    code      = as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[["code"]])))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(code), code_type %in% c("wvs_id","evs_id","party_id","party_id_2")) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

fr_wvs_ids <- fr_codes %>% dplyr::filter(code_type %in% c("wvs_id","party_id","party_id_2")) %>% dplyr::pull(code) %>% unique()
fr_evs_ids <- fr_codes %>% dplyr::filter(code_type %in% c("evs_id","party_id","party_id_2")) %>% dplyr::pull(code) %>% unique()

far_right_vote <- dplyr::case_when(
  party_source == "EVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_evs_ids ~ TRUE,
  party_source == "WVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_wvs_ids ~ TRUE,
  party_source %in% c("EVS","WVS") & !is.na(resp_party_id) ~ FALSE,
  TRUE ~ NA
)

##### ---- Decide X047 source by country-year ---------------------------------
x047_evs_raw <- to_num(ivs$X047_EVS %||% NA_real_)
x047_wvs_raw <- to_num(ivs$X047_WVS %||% NA_real_)

src_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  S009_code = normalize_s009(ivs$S009),
  year      = extract_year(ivs$S025),
  EVS_all_missing = is.na(x047_evs_raw) | x047_evs_raw == -4,
  WVS_all_missing = is.na(x047_wvs_raw) | x047_wvs_raw == -4
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(S009_code, year) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    all_evs_miss = all(EVS_all_missing),
    all_wvs_miss = all(WVS_all_missing),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(X047_source = dplyr::case_when(
    all_evs_miss & !all_wvs_miss ~ "WVS",
    all_wvs_miss & !all_evs_miss ~ "EVS",
    !all_evs_miss & !all_wvs_miss ~ "EVS",  # prefer EVS
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

##### ---- Minimal micro base + cleaning --------------------------------------
base0 <- ivs %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    S009_code     = normalize_s009(S009),
    year          = extract_year(S025),
    country_label = countrycode(S009_code, "iso2c", "country.name"),
    E033_num      = clean_general(E033),

    # Cleaned outcomes (F115 removed)
    C002 = if ("C002" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(C002) else NA_real_,
    C006 = if ("C006" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(C006) else NA_real_,
    G002 = if ("G002" %in% names(ivs)) clean_1to4(G002)   else NA_real_,
    G006 = if ("G006" %in% names(ivs)) clean_g006(G006)   else NA_real_,
    E114 = if ("E114" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(E114) else NA_real_,
    D059 = if ("D059" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(D059) else NA_real_,

    X047_EVS_clean = clean_x047_col(ivs$X047_EVS %||% NA_real_),
    X047_WVS_clean = clean_x047_col(ivs$X047_WVS %||% NA_real_),

    far_right_vote = far_right_vote
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(src_tbl, by = c("S009_code","year")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    X047 = dplyr::case_when(
      X047_source == "EVS" ~ X047_EVS_clean,
      X047_source == "WVS" ~ X047_WVS_clean,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Ideological group flags
base0 <- base0 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_left         = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 0   & E033_num <= 2.5,
    is_center_left  = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 2.5 & E033_num <= 5,
    is_tight_mod    = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 4   & E033_num <= 6,
    is_center_right = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >  5   & E033_num <= 7.5,
    is_right        = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >  7.5 & E033_num <= 10
  )

vars_to_mean <- intersect(c("C002","C006","G002","G006","E114","D059","X047"), names(base0))

##### ---- Dominant-group flags (X051 preferred; proxy fallback) --------------
get_col <- function(df, candidates) { hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]; if (length(hit)) df[[hit[1]]] else NULL }
norm_iso2 <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v)) return(rep(NA_character_, nrow(ivs)))
  y <- as.character(haven::as_factor(v))
  y <- toupper(y)
  y[y %in% c("", "NA", "NULL")] <- NA_character_
  y[y %in% c("UK","GB-GBN")] <- "GB"
  y[!grepl("^[A-Z]{2}$", y)] <- NA_character_
  y
}
is_yes1 <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v)) return(rep(NA, nrow(ivs)))
  neg_local <- c(-1L,-2L,-3L,-4L,-5L)
  x <- as.integer(haven::zap_labels(v))
  x[x %in% neg_local] <- NA_integer_
  x == 1L
}
choose_modal <- function(x){
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(x)) NA_character_ else names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

resp_birth <- norm_iso2(get_col(ivs, c("X002_02","v228b")))
dad_birth  <- norm_iso2(get_col(ivs, c("V001","v231b")))
mom_birth  <- norm_iso2(get_col(ivs, c("V002","v233b")))
dad_flag   <- is_yes1(get_col(ivs, c("v230")))
mom_flag   <- is_yes1(get_col(ivs, c("v232")))

survey_iso2 <- normalize_s009(ivs$S009)

resp_native <- ifelse(!is.na(resp_birth), resp_birth == survey_iso2, NA)
dad_native  <- dplyr::coalesce(dad_flag, ifelse(!is.na(dad_birth), dad_birth == survey_iso2, NA))
mom_native  <- dplyr::coalesce(mom_flag, ifelse(!is.na(mom_birth), mom_birth == survey_iso2, NA))

majority_native3 <- resp_native & dad_native & mom_native

x051_fac <- if ("X051" %in% names(ivs)) haven::as_factor(ivs$X051) else factor(NA)
x051_chr <- if ("X051" %in% names(ivs)) as.character(x051_fac) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(ivs))

x051_tbl <- tibble(
  S009_code = normalize_s009(ivs$S009),
  year      = extract_year(ivs$S025),
  X051_lab  = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(x051_fac, level = "(Missing)")
)
dom_map <- x051_tbl %>% dplyr::group_by(S009_code) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dominant_label = choose_modal(X051_lab), .groups = "drop")

base <- base0 %>%
  dplyr::bind_cols(tibble(majority_native3 = majority_native3)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dom_map, by = "S009_code") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    has_x051         = !is.na(x051_chr) & !is.na(dominant_label),
    is_dominant_x051 = has_x051 & (x051_chr == dominant_label),
    is_dominant      = dplyr::case_when(
      has_x051                             ~ is_dominant_x051,
      !has_x051 & !is.na(majority_native3) ~ majority_native3,
      TRUE                                 ~ NA
    )
  )

##### ---- Summariser with dominance shares + filters -------------------------
summarise_group_means <- function(df, group_flag, group_label, vars_to_mean){
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter({{ group_flag }}) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(S009_code, country_label, year) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_group               = dplyr::n(),
      income_source         = first_non_na(X047_source),
      dplyr::across(all_of(vars_to_mean), safe_mean, .names = "mean_{.col}"),
      n_far_right_obs       = sum(!is.na(far_right_vote)),
      n_far_right_yes       = sum(far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_far_right         = ifelse(n_far_right_obs > 0, 100 * n_far_right_yes / n_far_right_obs, NA_real_),
      n_dom_obs_in_group    = sum(!is.na(is_dominant)),
      n_dom_yes_in_group    = sum(is_dominant %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_dominant_in_group = ifelse(n_dom_obs_in_group > 0, 100 * n_dom_yes_in_group / n_dom_obs_in_group, NA_real_),
      n_dom_yes_among_fr    = sum(is_dominant %in% TRUE & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_dominant_among_fr = ifelse(n_far_right_yes > 0, 100 * n_dom_yes_among_fr / n_far_right_yes, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(country_label, year) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(group = group_label) %>%
    dplyr::select(group, country_label, S009_code, year, income_source,
                  n_group, pct_far_right, n_far_right_yes, n_far_right_obs,
                  pct_dominant_in_group, pct_dominant_among_fr,
                  dplyr::starts_with("mean_"))
}

filter_countries_by_fr <- function(df){
  keep <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(S009_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(any_fr = any(pct_far_right > 0, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(any_fr) %>% dplyr::pull(S009_code)
  df %>% dplyr::filter(S009_code %in% keep)
}
filter_min_obs <- function(df, min_years = 4){
  keep <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(S009_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_years = dplyr::n_distinct(year), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_years >= min_years) %>% dplyr::pull(S009_code)
  df %>% dplyr::filter(S009_code %in% keep)
}

##### ---- CSVs (groups) ------------------------------------------------------
lf_means <- summarise_group_means(base, is_left,         "Left (0–2.5)",          vars_to_mean) %>%
  filter_countries_by_fr() %>% filter_min_obs()
cl_means <- summarise_group_means(base, is_center_left,  "Center-left (2.5–5)",   vars_to_mean) %>%
  filter_countries_by_fr() %>% filter_min_obs()
tm_means <- summarise_group_means(base, is_tight_mod,    "Tight moderates (4–6)", vars_to_mean) %>%
  filter_countries_by_fr() %>% filter_min_obs()
cr_means <- summarise_group_means(base, is_center_right, "Center-right (5–7.5]",  vars_to_mean) %>%
  filter_countries_by_fr() %>% filter_min_obs()
rt_means <- summarise_group_means(base, is_right,        "Right (7.5–10)",        vars_to_mean) %>%
  filter_countries_by_fr() %>% filter_min_obs()

readr::write_csv(lf_means, file.path(out_dir_csv, "country_year_means_left.csv"))
readr::write_csv(cl_means, file.path(out_dir_csv, "country_year_means_center_left.csv"))

# Re-usable helper: box+whisker across countries (country-year means on y),
# flipped so the displayed x-axis runs from 1..4.
make_bw_pdf_for_vars <- function(df, fname_slug, group_label){
  vars <- intersect(c("mean_G002","mean_E114"), names(df))
  if (length(vars) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  pdf(file.path(out_dir_plots, paste0("boxwhisker_", fname_slug, ".pdf")),
      width = 12, height = 8.5)

  for (mv in vars) {
    d <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(country_label, S009_code, year, !!sym(mv)) %>%
      dplyr::rename(value = !!sym(mv)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))
    if (nrow(d) == 0) next

    p <- ggplot(
      d,
      aes(x = reorder(country_label, value, FUN = median, na.rm = TRUE), y = value)
    ) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_jitter(aes(color = factor(year)),
                  width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.45, size = 1.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
      coord_flip() +
      # The numeric axis (value) is on Y before flip, so set Y limits to 1..4
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1,4), breaks = 1:4) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Across countries — ", mv, " — ", group_label),
        x = "Country",
        y = mv
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
      # If your mean_E114 isn’t on a 1–4 scale, comment the limits line above for that page.

    print(p)
  }

  dev.off()
}

# Make the two-page PDFs for each ideological group
make_bw_pdf_for_vars(lf_means, "left",          "Left (0–2.5)")
make_bw_pdf_for_vars(cl_means, "center_left",   "Center-left (2.5–5)")
make_bw_pdf_for_vars(tm_means, "tight_mods",    "Tight moderates (4–6)")
make_bw_pdf_for_vars(cr_means, "center_right",  "Center-right (5–7.5]")
make_bw_pdf_for_vars(rt_means, "right",         "Right (7.5–10)")

message("Wrote plot PDFs to: ", normalizePath(out_dir_plots))
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(fixest); library(broom) })

# If tm_means already exists from your pipeline, it will be used; else read it:
if (!exists("tm_means")) {
  tm_means <- readr::read_csv(file.path(out_dir_csv, "country_year_means_tight_moderates.csv"),
                              show_col_types = FALSE)
}

# Standardize predictors so effects are per 1 SD change; outcome is in percentage points
tm_mod <- tm_means %>%
  transmute(
    S009_code, year, country_label, n_group,
    y   = pct_far_right,                 # 0–100 (pp)
    sC006 = as.numeric(scale(mean_C006)),
    sC002 = as.numeric(scale(mean_C002)),
    sG006 = as.numeric(scale(mean_G006)),
    sE114 = as.numeric(scale(mean_E114)),
    sD059 = as.numeric(scale(mean_D059))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(y, sC006, sC002, sG006, sE114, sD059, S009_code, year, n_group)

# Joint model: country & year FE, weights = group size, clustered SEs by country
m_joint <- feols(
  y ~ sC006 * (sC002 + sG006 + sE114 + sD059) | S009_code + year,
  data = tm_mod,
  weights = ~ n_group,
  cluster = ~ S009_code
)

# ---- Simple slopes of each predictor at LOW C006 (−1 SD) -------------------
# delta-method using the clustered vcov from the model
slope_at_C006 <- function(model, var_mod, zC006 = -1) {
  b <- coef(model)
  V <- vcov(model)

  nm_mod <- var_mod                      # e.g., "sC002"
  nm_int <- paste0("sC006:", var_mod)
  if (!nm_int %in% names(b)) nm_int <- paste0(var_mod, ":sC006")  # safety for term order

  # slope of var_mod when sC006 = zC006
  slope <- b[[nm_mod]] + zC006 * b[[nm_int]]
  var   <- V[nm_mod, nm_mod] + (zC006^2) * V[nm_int, nm_int] + 2 * zC006 * V[nm_mod, nm_int]
  se    <- sqrt(var)
  zval  <- slope / se
  pval  <- 2 * pnorm(abs(zval), lower.tail = FALSE)

  tibble::tibble(
    predictor = sub("^s", "", var_mod),  # drop the leading 's'
    C006_level = "Low (−1 SD)",
    marginal_effect_pp = slope,          # pp change in far-right share per +1 SD predictor
    conf.low = slope - 1.96 * se,
    conf.high = slope + 1.96 * se,
    p.value = pval
  )
}

mods <- c("sC002","sG006","sE114","sD059")
me_lowC006 <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(mods, function(v) slope_at_C006(m_joint, v, zC006 = -1)))

print(me_lowC006)

# Optional: save to CSV
readr::write_csv(me_lowC006, file.path(out_dir_csv, "tm_marginal_effects_of_predictors_at_low_C006.csv"))
```

```{r}
# ---- Marginal effects for tight moderates at AVG (0 SD) and HIGH (+1 SD) C006 ----
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(fixest); library(dplyr); library(tibble)
})

# 1) Prep: z-score the predictors in the country–year table for moderates
tmz <- tm_means %>%
  mutate(
    z_C006 = as.numeric(scale(mean_C006)),
    z_C002 = as.numeric(scale(mean_C002)),
    z_G006 = as.numeric(scale(mean_G006)),
    z_E114 = as.numeric(scale(mean_E114)),
    z_D059 = as.numeric(scale(mean_D059)),
    share_fr = pct_far_right # already in percentage points
  )

# 2) FE OLS with interactions (country & year fixed effects), weights, clustered SEs
mod_tm <- feols(
  share_fr ~ z_C002 + z_G006 + z_E114 + z_D059 + z_C006 +
    z_C002:z_C006 + z_G006:z_C006 + z_E114:z_C006 + z_D059:z_C006 |
    S009_code + year,
  data = tmz,
  weights = ~ n_group,
  cluster = ~ S009_code
)

# Helper to fetch the interaction name regardless of order
int_name <- function(main, with, cn) {
  a <- paste0(main, ":", with)
  b <- paste0(with, ":", main)
  if (a %in% cn) a else if (b %in% cn) b else NA_character_
}

# 3) Marginal effects function: β_main + z * β_inter, with robust SE via delta method
margins_at <- function(model, z_vals = c(`Average (0 SD)` = 0, `High (+1 SD)` = 1),
                       mains = c("z_C002","z_G006","z_E114","z_D059"),
                       by = "z_C006") {
  cf  <- coef(model)
  V   <- vcov(model)               # clustered vcov (from estimation)
  cns <- names(cf)

  out <- lapply(names(z_vals), function(lbl){
    z <- unname(z_vals[[lbl]])
    bind_rows(lapply(mains, function(mn){
      inter <- int_name(mn, by, cns)
      if (is.na(inter) || !(mn %in% cns)) return(NULL)

      # linear combination L'β
      L <- rep(0, length(cf)); names(L) <- cns
      L[mn] <- 1
      L[inter] <- z
      est <- as.numeric(t(L) %*% cf)
      se  <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(L) %*% V %*% L))
      zstat <- est / se
      pval  <- 2 * pnorm(abs(zstat), lower.tail = FALSE)

      tibble(
        predictor = sub("^z_", "", mn),
        C006_level = lbl,
        marginal_effect_pp = est,               # pp change per +1 SD in predictor
        conf.low  = est - 1.96 * se,
        conf.high = est + 1.96 * se,
        p.value   = pval
      )
    }))
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  arrange(out, C006_level, predictor)
}

me_tm_avg_high <- margins_at(mod_tm)
print(me_tm_avg_high, n = Inf)
```
