```{r}
         fr = as.numeric(far_right_vote))  # 0/1

# 2) LPM with country & year FE; two-way clustered SEs (country and year)
mod_tm_lpm <- feols(
  fr ~ z_C002 + z_G006 + z_E114 + z_D059 + z_C006 +
        z_C002:z_C006 + z_G006:z_C006 + z_E114:z_C006 + z_D059:z_C006 |
        S009_code + year,
  data    = micro_tm,
  cluster = ~ S009_code + year
  # , weights = ~ S017   # uncomment if you have survey weights
)

summary(mod_tm_lpm)

# 3) Delta-method MEs: effect of +1 SD in each predictor at C006 ∈ {−1,0,+1}
int_name <- function(main, with, cn) {
  a <- paste0(main, ":", with); b <- paste0(with, ":", main)
  if (a %in% cn) a else if (b %in% cn) b else NA_character_
}

margins_at <- function(model, z_vals = c(`Low (−1 SD)`=-1, `Average (0 SD)`=0, `High (+1 SD)`=1),
                       mains = c("z_C002","z_G006","z_E114","z_D059"), by = "z_C006") {
  cf  <- coef(model); V <- vcov(model); cns <- names(cf)
  bind_rows(lapply(names(z_vals), function(lbl){
    z <- unname(z_vals[[lbl]])
    bind_rows(lapply(mains, function(mn){
      inter <- int_name(mn, by, cns)
      if (is.na(inter) || !(mn %in% cns)) return(NULL)
      L <- rep(0, length(cf)); names(L) <- cns
      L[mn] <- 1; L[inter] <- z
      est <- as.numeric(t(L) %*% cf)
      se  <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(L) %*% V %*% L))
      tibble(
        predictor = sub("^z_", "", mn),
        C006_level = lbl,
        marginal_effect_pp = est * 100,
        conf.low  = (est - 1.96*se) * 100,
        conf.high = (est + 1.96*se) * 100,
        p.value   = 2 * pnorm(abs(est/se), lower.tail = FALSE)
      )
    }))
  }))
}

me_tm_lpm <- margins_at(mod_tm_lpm)
me_tm_lpm
```

```{r}
##### ======================= Libraries & Paths ================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(haven)
  library(readr)
  library(countrycode)
  library(gridExtra)   # for tableGrob fallback in chunk 2b & joint table
})

ivs_path       <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/Integrated_values_surveys_1981-2022.dta"
fr_codes_path  <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/far_right_party_codes.csv"

out_dir_csv    <- "out"
out_dir_plots  <- "out/plots"
dir.create(out_dir_csv,   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir_plots, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

MIN_WAVES <- 4  # country must have at least this many distinct survey years


##### =========================== Helpers =====================================
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
neg_codes <- -5:-1

extract_year <- function(x){
  if (is.numeric(x)) { y <- floor(x); y %% 10000 } else {
    first <- stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d{4}"); suppressWarnings(as.integer(first))
  }
}
normalize_s009 <- function(x){ y <- as.character(x); y[y %in% c("GB-GBN","UK")] <- "GB"; y }

to_num <- function(x) as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(x))
first_non_na <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (length(x)) x[[1]] else NA }

clean_general <- function(x){ xi <- to_num(x); xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_; xi[xi <= 0] <- NA_real_; xi }
clean_1to4    <- function(x){ xi <- to_num(x); xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_; xi[!(xi>=1 & xi<=4)] <- NA_real_; xi }
clean_1to10   <- function(x){ xi <- to_num(x); xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_; xi[!(xi>=1 & xi<=10)] <- NA_real_; xi }
clean_0_1     <- function(x){ xi <- to_num(x); xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_; xi[!(xi %in% c(0,1))] <- NA_real_; xi }

# X047 (income scale) cleaner (EVS/WVS):
clean_x047_col <- function(x){
  xi <- to_num(x)
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi == -4] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi <= 0] <- NA_real_
  xi[!(xi >= 1 & xi <= 10)] <- NA_real_
  xi
}

safe_mean <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
safe_prop <- function(x) { y <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (!length(y)) NA_real_ else mean(y) }


##### ====================== Load + Minimal Micro Base =========================
# --- add to needed_cols ---
needed_cols <- c(
  "S009","S025","E033",
  "C002","C006","G002","G006","E114","D059",
  "E003","E035","E036","E037","E039",
  "A124_06",
  "X037_01",  # <--- NEW
  "X047_EVS","X047_WVS","X047WVS",
  "E179_WVS","E179WVS","E179","E181A",
  "X051","X002_02","v228b","V001","v231b","v230","V002","v233b","v232"
)

ivs <- haven::read_dta(ivs_path, col_select = tidyselect::any_of(needed_cols))

# normalize column names we’ve seen vary:
if ("X047WVS" %in% names(ivs) && !("X047_WVS" %in% names(ivs))) {
  ivs <- dplyr::rename(ivs, X047_WVS = X047WVS)
}
if ("E179WVS" %in% names(ivs) && !("E179_WVS" %in% names(ivs))) {
  ivs <- dplyr::rename(ivs, E179_WVS = E179WVS)
}

# Respondent party ID + source
wvs_party_raw <- dplyr::coalesce(clean_general(ivs$E179_WVS), clean_general(ivs$E179))
evs_party_raw <- clean_general(ivs$E181A)
resp_party_id <- dplyr::coalesce(wvs_party_raw, evs_party_raw)
party_source  <- dplyr::case_when(!is.na(wvs_party_raw) ~ "WVS",
                                  !is.na(evs_party_raw) ~ "EVS",
                                  TRUE ~ NA_character_)

# Far-right party codes
fr_codes <- readr::read_csv(fr_codes_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(tolower) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code_type = tolower(as.character(.data[["code_type"]])),
    code      = as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(.data[["code"]])))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(code), code_type %in% c("wvs_id","evs_id","party_id","party_id_2")) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

fr_wvs_ids <- fr_codes %>% dplyr::filter(code_type %in% c("wvs_id","party_id","party_id_2")) %>% dplyr::pull(code) %>% unique()
fr_evs_ids <- fr_codes %>% dplyr::filter(code_type %in% c("evs_id","party_id","party_id_2")) %>% dplyr::pull(code) %>% unique()

far_right_vote <- dplyr::case_when(
  party_source == "EVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_evs_ids ~ TRUE,
  party_source == "WVS" & !is.na(resp_party_id) & resp_party_id %in% fr_wvs_ids ~ TRUE,
  party_source %in% c("EVS","WVS") & !is.na(resp_party_id) ~ FALSE,
  TRUE ~ NA
)

# Decide X047 source by country-year
x047_evs_raw <- to_num(ivs$X047_EVS %||% NA_real_)
x047_wvs_raw <- to_num(ivs$X047_WVS %||% NA_real_)

src_tbl <- tibble(
  S009_code = normalize_s009(ivs$S009),
  year      = extract_year(ivs$S025),
  EVS_all_missing = is.na(x047_evs_raw) | x047_evs_raw == -4,
  WVS_all_missing = is.na(x047_wvs_raw) | x047_wvs_raw == -4
) %>%
  group_by(S009_code, year) %>%
  summarise(
    all_evs_miss = all(EVS_all_missing),
    all_wvs_miss = all(WVS_all_missing),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(X047_source = case_when(
    all_evs_miss & !all_wvs_miss ~ "WVS",
    all_wvs_miss & !all_evs_miss ~ "EVS",
    !all_evs_miss & !all_wvs_miss ~ "EVS",  # prefer EVS when both exist
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

# Base micro with cleaned vars (and items for chunk 2)
# --- add to base0 transmute (keep your other lines as-is) ---
base0 <- ivs %>%
  transmute(
    S009_code     = normalize_s009(S009),
    year          = extract_year(S025),
    country_label = countrycode(S009_code, "iso2c", "country.name"),
    E033_num      = clean_general(E033),
    C002 = if ("C002" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(C002) else NA_real_,
    C006 = if ("C006" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(C006) else NA_real_,
    G002 = if ("G002" %in% names(ivs)) clean_1to4(G002)   else NA_real_,
    G006 = if ("G006" %in% names(ivs)) clean_1to4(G006)   else NA_real_,
    E114 = if ("E114" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(E114) else NA_real_,
    D059 = if ("D059" %in% names(ivs)) clean_general(D059) else NA_real_,
    E003_14  = if ("E003" %in% names(ivs)) clean_1to4(E003)   else NA_real_,
    E035_10  = if ("E035" %in% names(ivs)) clean_1to10(E035)  else NA_real_,
    E036_10  = if ("E036" %in% names(ivs)) clean_1to10(E036)  else NA_real_,
    E037_10  = if ("E037" %in% names(ivs)) clean_1to10(E037)  else NA_real_,
    E039_10  = if ("E039" %in% names(ivs)) clean_1to10(E039)  else NA_real_,
    A124_06  = if ("A124_06" %in% names(ivs)) clean_0_1(A124_06) else NA_real_,
    X037_01  = if ("X037_01" %in% names(ivs)) to_num(X037_01)    else NA_real_,  # <--- NEW
    X047_EVS_clean = clean_x047_col(ivs$X047_EVS %||% NA_real_),
    X047_WVS_clean = clean_x047_col(ivs$X047_WVS %||% NA_real_),
    far_right_vote = far_right_vote
  ) %>%
  left_join(src_tbl, by = c("S009_code","year")) %>%
  mutate(
    X047 = case_when(
      X047_source == "EVS" ~ X047_EVS_clean,
      X047_source == "WVS" ~ X047_WVS_clean,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    is_moderate_4_7 = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 4 & E033_num <= 7,
    is_left_1_3     = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 1 & E033_num <= 3,
    is_right_8_10   = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 8 & E033_num <= 10
  )

# Slope check formatting
bucketed <- base0 %>%
  mutate(
    is_left_1_2_new   = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 1 & E033_num <= 2,
    is_mod_3_8_new    = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 3 & E033_num <= 8,
    is_right_9_10_new = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 9 & E033_num <= 10
  )

fr_by_bucket_new <- bucketed %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label, year) %>%
  summarise(
    # left 1-2
    n_fr_obs_left_new  = sum(is_left_1_2_new   & !is.na(far_right_vote)),
    n_fr_yes_left_new  = sum(is_left_1_2_new   & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_fr_left_new    = ifelse(n_fr_obs_left_new  > 0,
                                100 * n_fr_yes_left_new / n_fr_obs_left_new,
                                NA_real_),

    # moderate 3-8
    n_fr_obs_mod_new   = sum(is_mod_3_8_new    & !is.na(far_right_vote)),
    n_fr_yes_mod_new   = sum(is_mod_3_8_new    & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_fr_mod_new     = ifelse(n_fr_obs_mod_new   > 0,
                                100 * n_fr_yes_mod_new / n_fr_obs_mod_new,
                                NA_real_),

    # right 9-10
    n_fr_obs_right_new = sum(is_right_9_10_new & !is.na(far_right_vote)),
    n_fr_yes_right_new = sum(is_right_9_10_new & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_fr_right_new   = ifelse(n_fr_obs_right_new > 0,
                                100 * n_fr_yes_right_new / n_fr_obs_right_new,
                                NA_real_),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

##### ========================= Country Filters ===============================
# Build moderate-only country-year summary to derive "keep" set:
mod_cy <- base0 %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label, year) %>%
  summarise(
    # totals + moderates' population share (bars)
    n_total               = n(),
    n_moderate            = sum(is_moderate_4_7, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_moderate_in_total = ifelse(n_total > 0, 100 * n_moderate / n_total, NA_real_),

    # % FR among Left (1–3), Moderates (4–7), Right (8–10)
    n_fr_obs_left  = sum(is_left_1_3     & !is.na(far_right_vote)),
    n_fr_yes_left  = sum(is_left_1_3     & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_fr_among_left = ifelse(n_fr_obs_left  > 0, 100 * n_fr_yes_left  / n_fr_obs_left,  NA_real_),

    n_fr_obs_mod   = sum(is_moderate_4_7 & !is.na(far_right_vote)),
    n_fr_yes_mod   = sum(is_moderate_4_7 & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_fr_among_moderate = ifelse(n_fr_obs_mod > 0, 100 * n_fr_yes_mod / n_fr_obs_mod, NA_real_),

    n_fr_obs_right = sum(is_right_8_10   & !is.na(far_right_vote)),
    n_fr_yes_right = sum(is_right_8_10   & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_fr_among_right = ifelse(n_fr_obs_right > 0, 100 * n_fr_yes_right / n_fr_obs_right, NA_real_),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Base keep set: min waves & ever non-zero FR among moderates
keep_countries_base <- mod_cy %>%
  group_by(S009_code) %>%
  summarise(
    n_years = n_distinct(year),
    any_fr  = any(pct_fr_among_moderate > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_years >= MIN_WAVES, any_fr) %>%
  pull(S009_code)

# Further restrict: FR_moderates (nearest to 2020) > (nearest to 2010)
closest_idx <- function(y, target) which.min(abs(y - target))
trend_comp <- mod_cy %>%
  filter(S009_code %in% keep_countries_base) %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label) %>%
  summarise(
    i10   = closest_idx(year, 2010),
    i20   = closest_idx(year, 2020),
    y2010 = year[i10],
    fr10  = pct_fr_among_moderate[i10],
    y2020 = year[i20],
    fr20  = pct_fr_among_moderate[i20],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fr10), !is.na(fr20))

keep_countries_trend <- trend_comp %>%
  filter(fr20 > fr10) %>%
  pull(S009_code)

# Final set used everywhere later:
keep_countries <- intersect(keep_countries_base, keep_countries_trend)
message(sprintf("Countries passing 2010→2020 FR-moderates increase: %d of %d (final keep set).",
                length(keep_countries), length(keep_countries_base)))

#### ===== SLOPE CHECK: Is FR support among moderates rising fastest? ===== ####
# We work with *all* eligible countries before the 2010→2020 restriction
# so use keep_countries_base, not keep_countries

# helper: index of survey wave closest to a target year
closest_idx <- function(y, target) which.min(abs(y - target))

# For each country, grab the wave closest to 2010 and to 2020,
# then compute level in each group and the per-year slope.
slope_10_20 <- mod_cy %>%
  filter(S009_code %in% keep_countries_base) %>%
  arrange(S009_code, year) %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label) %>%
  summarise(
    # which row is closest to 2010? closest to 2020?
    i10 = closest_idx(year, 2010),
    i20 = closest_idx(year, 2020),

    # extract the actual years at those indices
    year_10 = year[i10],
    year_20 = year[i20],

    # extract FR % for Left, Moderates, Right at those two waves
    frL_10  = pct_fr_among_left[i10],
    frL_20  = pct_fr_among_left[i20],
    frM_10  = pct_fr_among_moderate[i10],
    frM_20  = pct_fr_among_moderate[i20],
    frR_10  = pct_fr_among_right[i10],
    frR_20  = pct_fr_among_right[i20],

    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  # now outside summarise but still within group_by
  mutate(
    # time gap
    dt_years = year_20 - year_10,

    # raw change in pp (20 minus 10)
    dL_pp = frL_20 - frL_10,
    dM_pp = frM_20 - frM_10,
    dR_pp = frR_20 - frR_10,

    # slope per calendar year (pp per year). If dt_years == 0, set NA
    slope_left      = ifelse(dt_years > 0, dL_pp / dt_years, NA_real_),
    slope_moderate  = ifelse(dt_years > 0, dM_pp / dt_years, NA_real_),
    slope_right     = ifelse(dt_years > 0, dR_pp / dt_years, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # toss countries where we couldn't get both endpoints or got NAs
  filter(
    !is.na(slope_left) |
    !is.na(slope_moderate) |
    !is.na(slope_right)
  )

# Save a wide CSV: one row per country with all 3 slopes and the underlying levels
readr::write_csv(
  slope_10_20,
  file.path(out_dir_csv, "fr_support_slopes_2010to2020_by_bucket.csv")
)

# Make a long version for plotting
slope_long <- slope_10_20 %>%
  select(S009_code, country_label,
         slope_left, slope_moderate, slope_right) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(slope_left, slope_moderate, slope_right),
    names_to = "bucket",
    values_to = "slope_pp_per_year"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bucket = case_when(
      bucket == "slope_left"     ~ "Left (1–3)",
      bucket == "slope_moderate" ~ "Moderate (4–7)",
      bucket == "slope_right"    ~ "Right (8–10)",
      TRUE ~ bucket
    )
  )

# Color mapping as requested
bucket_colors <- c(
  "Left (1–3)"      = "blue",
  "Moderate (4–7)"  = "yellow",
  "Right (8–10)"    = "red"
)

# Scatterplot:
#   x-axis: country (categorical)
#   y-axis: slope in pp-per-year
#   color: ideology bucket
#
# Interpretation:
#   Higher point = faster annualized *increase* in far-right vote share for that group.
#   If yellow dots (moderates) tend to sit above blue/red for the same country,
#   moderates are gaining faster.
pdf(file.path(out_dir_plots, "slope_scatter_2010to2020_FRsupport_by_bucket.pdf"),
    width = 11, height = 6)

ggplot(slope_long,
       aes(x = reorder(country_label, slope_pp_per_year, FUN = median, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = slope_pp_per_year,
           color = bucket)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = bucket_colors) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Rise in far-right support per year, ~2010→~2020",
    subtitle = "Slope = (FR%_2020 − FR%_2010) / (year_2020 − year_2010)\nHigher = faster growth in far-right voting",
    x = "Country",
    y = "Slope (percentage points of FR support gained per calendar year)",
    color = "Ideology bucket"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

dev.off()

##### === CHUNK 1b (TABLE): FR%, mean C006, and X037_01 (%==1 when C006 missing) ===

mod_tbl <- base0 %>%
  filter(is_moderate_4_7, S009_code %in% keep_countries) %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label, year) %>%
  summarise(
    # FR% among moderates
    n_fr_obs   = sum(!is.na(far_right_vote)),
    n_fr_yes   = sum(far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_fr_mod = ifelse(n_fr_obs > 0, 100 * n_fr_yes / n_fr_obs, NA_real_),

    # C006 mean + availability
    mean_C006    = safe_mean(C006),
    n_c006_valid = sum(!is.na(C006)),

    # X037_01: %==1 among responses not equal to 8 or 9
    n_x037_valid = sum(!is.na(X037_01) & !(X037_01 %in% c(8, 9))),
    pct_x0371_all = ifelse(
      n_x037_valid > 0,
      100 * sum(X037_01 == 1 & !(X037_01 %in% c(8, 9)), na.rm = TRUE) / n_x037_valid,
      NA_real_
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(S009_code, year) %>%
  # Mask X037_01 unless C006 is missing that year
  mutate(
    pct_x0371_when_C006_missing = ifelse(n_c006_valid == 0 | is.na(mean_C006), pct_x0371_all, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    S009_code, country_label, year,
    pct_fr_moderates = round(pct_fr_mod, 1),
    mean_C006        = round(mean_C006, 2),
    pct_X03701_eq1_when_C006_missing = round(pct_x0371_when_C006_missing, 1)
  )

# Save CSV
readr::write_csv(mod_tbl, file.path(out_dir_csv, "chunk1b_moderates_FR_C006_X03701_table.csv"))

        core   = list(fg_params = list(cex = 0.85)),
        colhead= list(fg_params = list(cex = 0.95, fontface = 2))
      )
    )
  )
  grid::grid.text(
    paste0(unique(d$country_label), " — Moderates: FR%, mean C006, and X037_01 (only when C006 missing)"),
    x = 0.02, y = 0.98, just = "left",
    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")
  )
}
dev.off()

##### ===== CHUNK 2a: L/M/R ideology index (E035+revE036+E037+revE039) ========
# Strict "add up": only sum if all four are present; else NA
items <- base0 %>%
  transmute(
    S009_code, country_label, year, E033_num,
    E035 = E035_10, E036 = E036_10, E037 = E037_10, E039 = E039_10
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    E036_rev = ifelse(is.na(E036), NA_real_, 11 - E036),
    E039_rev = ifelse(is.na(E039), NA_real_, 11 - E039),
    index_sum = ifelse(
      rowSums(is.na(cbind(E035, E036_rev, E037, E039_rev))) == 0,
      E035 + E036_rev + E037 + E039_rev,
      NA_real_
    ),
    bucket = case_when(
      !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 1 & E033_num <= 3  ~ "Left (1–3)",
      !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 4 & E033_num <= 7  ~ "Moderate (4–7)",
      !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 8 & E033_num <= 10 ~ "Right (8–10)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

idx_cy <- items %>%
  filter(!is.na(bucket)) %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label, year, bucket) %>%
  summarise(mean_index = mean(index_sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(S009_code %in% keep_countries)

pdf(file.path(out_dir_plots, "chunk2a_ideology_index_by_country.pdf"), width = 10, height = 7)
for (cc in unique(idx_cy$S009_code)) {
  d <- idx_cy %>% filter(S009_code == cc)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = year, y = mean_index, color = bucket)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_point(size = 1.7) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(unique(d$country_label),
                     " — Index: E035 + rev(E036) + E037 + rev(E039)"),
      x = "Year", y = "Average index (4–40)", color = "Bucket"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  print(p)
}
dev.off()


##### ===== CHUNK 2b: L/M/R E003 (1..4) shares as tables (one PDF) ============
# Table schema: columns = wave(year), bucket, %1, %2, %3, %4
e003_cy <- base0 %>%
  transmute(S009_code, country_label, year, bucket = case_when(
              !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 1 & E033_num <= 3  ~ "Left (1–3)",
              !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 4 & E033_num <= 7  ~ "Moderate (4–7)",
              !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 8 & E033_num <= 10 ~ "Right (8–10)",
              TRUE ~ NA_character_),
            E003_14 = E003_14) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bucket), !is.na(E003_14)) %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label, year, bucket) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pct_1 = 100*mean(E003_14 == 1),
    pct_2 = 100*mean(E003_14 == 2),
    pct_3 = 100*mean(E003_14 == 3),
    pct_4 = 100*mean(E003_14 == 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(S009_code %in% keep_countries) %>%
  arrange(S009_code, year, bucket)

pdf(file.path(out_dir_plots, "chunk2b_E003_tables_by_country.pdf"), width = 11, height = 8.5)
for (cc in unique(e003_cy$S009_code)) {
  d <- e003_cy %>% filter(S009_code == cc) %>%
    transmute(
      `Wave (Year)` = year,
      Bucket = bucket,
      `% Answer 1` = round(pct_1, 1),
      `% Answer 2` = round(pct_2, 1),
      `% Answer 3` = round(pct_3, 1),
      `% Answer 4` = round(pct_4, 1)
    )
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(
    tableGrob(
      d, rows = NULL, theme = gridExtra::ttheme_minimal(
        core = list(fg_params = list(cex = 0.8)),
        colhead = list(fg_params = list(cex = 0.9, fontface = 2))
      )
    )
  )
  grid::grid.text(
    paste0(unique(e003_cy$country_label[e003_cy$S009_code == cc]),
           " — E003 response shares (by bucket)"),
    x = 0.02, y = 0.98, just = "left",
    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")
  )
}
dev.off()

##### === Utility: moderate country-year means & deltas (for joint table) =====
mod_means <- base0 %>%
  filter(is_moderate_4_7, S009_code %in% keep_countries) %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label, year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_G006     = safe_mean(G006),
    mean_C006     = safe_mean(C006),
    mean_X047     = safe_mean(X047),
    n_A124_valid  = sum(!is.na(A124_06)),
    pct_ans1      = ifelse(n_A124_valid > 0,
                           100 * sum(A124_06 == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n_A124_valid,
                           NA_real_),
    n_fr_obs      = sum(!is.na(far_right_vote)),
    n_fr_yes      = sum(far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_FR        = ifelse(n_fr_obs > 0, 100 * n_fr_yes / n_fr_obs, NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(S009_code, year)

mod_deltas <- mod_means %>%
  group_by(S009_code) %>%
  arrange(year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    start_year = dplyr::lag(year),
    d_pct_FR   = pct_FR   - dplyr::lag(pct_FR),
    d_C006     = mean_C006 - dplyr::lag(mean_C006),
    d_A1241    = pct_ans1 - dplyr::lag(pct_ans1)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_year)) %>%
  ungroup()


##### === NEW CHUNK 4: Joint-trend periods table (CSV + PDF) ==================
# Keep adjacent-wave periods where FR↑, C006↓ (toward 1), and A124_06('1')↑
joint_periods <- mod_deltas %>%
  filter(d_pct_FR > 0, d_C006 < 0, d_A1241 > 0) %>%
  transmute(
    S009_code, country_label,
    start_year, end_year = year,
    delta_pct_FR    = round(d_pct_FR, 1),
    delta_C006      = round(d_C006, 3),
    delta_pct_A1241 = round(d_A1241, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(S009_code, start_year, end_year)

readr::write_csv(joint_periods, file.path(out_dir_csv, "joint_trend_periods_moderates.csv"))

pdf(file.path(out_dir_plots, "joint_trend_periods_moderates.pdf"), width = 11, height = 8.5)
if (nrow(joint_periods) == 0) {
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.text("No periods satisfy FR↑, C006↓, and A124_06('1')↑ under current filters.",
                  x = 0.5, y = 0.5, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))
} else {
  for (cc in unique(joint_periods$S009_code)) {
    d <- joint_periods %>% filter(S009_code == cc)
    grid::grid.newpage()
    grid::grid.draw(
      gridExtra::tableGrob(
        d %>% select(start_year, end_year, delta_pct_FR, delta_C006, delta_pct_A1241),
        rows = NULL,
        theme = gridExtra::ttheme_minimal(
          core = list(fg_params = list(cex = 0.85)),
          colhead = list(fg_params = list(cex = 0.95, fontface = 2))
        )
      )
    )
    grid::grid.text(
      paste0(unique(d$country_label), " — Joint-trend periods (moderates)"),
      x = 0.02, y = 0.98, just = "left",
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")
    )
  }
}
dev.off()

message("All chunks completed. Outputs written to: ",
        normalizePath(out_dir_plots), " and ", normalizePath(out_dir_csv))
```

```{r}
##### === CHUNK 4 (Simple, 2010–2020 overlap): FR↑ & C006↓ ===================
# Requires `mod_means` with: S009_code, country_label, year, pct_FR, mean_C006

yr_min <- 2010L
yr_max <- 2020L

fr_up_c006_down_raw <- mod_means %>%
  dplyr::group_by(S009_code) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    start_year    = dplyr::lag(year),
    delta_pct_FR  = pct_FR    - dplyr::lag(pct_FR),   # + = FR share rising (pp)
    delta_C006    = mean_C006 - dplyr::lag(mean_C006) # − = satisfaction falling (toward 1)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(start_year)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(delta_pct_FR > 0, delta_C006 < 0)

# Keep only periods where at least one endpoint is within [2010, 2020]
fr_up_c006_down <- fr_up_c006_down_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::between(start_year, yr_min, yr_max) |
                dplyr::between(year,       yr_min, yr_max)) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    S009_code, country_label,
    start_year, end_year = year,
    delta_pct_FR = round(delta_pct_FR, 1),
    delta_C006   = round(delta_C006, 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(S009_code, start_year, end_year)

# Save detailed CSV and counts-by-country
readr::write_csv(
  fr_up_c006_down,
  file.path(out_dir_csv, "periods_FRup_C006down_moderates_2010_2020.csv")
)

summary_counts <- fr_up_c006_down %>%
  dplyr::count(S009_code, country_label, name = "n_periods") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_periods))
readr::write_csv(
  summary_counts,
  file.path(out_dir_csv, "periods_FRup_C006down_moderates_counts_by_country_2010_2020.csv")
)

# One PDF with a simple table per country
pdf(file.path(out_dir_plots, "periods_FRup_C006down_moderates_2010_2020.pdf"),
    width = 11, height = 8.5)

if (nrow(fr_up_c006_down) == 0) {
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.text("No periods satisfy FR↑ & C006↓ with an endpoint in 2010–2020.",
                  x = 0.5, y = 0.5, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))
} else {
  for (cc in unique(fr_up_c006_down$S009_code)) {
    d <- fr_up_c006_down %>%
      dplyr::filter(S009_code == cc) %>%
      dplyr::select(start_year, end_year, delta_pct_FR, delta_C006)

    grid::grid.newpage()
    grid::grid.draw(
      gridExtra::tableGrob(
        d, rows = NULL,
        theme = gridExtra::ttheme_minimal(
          core   = list(fg_params = list(cex = 0.85)),
          colhead= list(fg_params = list(cex = 0.95, fontface = 2))
        )
      )
    )
    grid::grid.text(
      paste0(unique(fr_up_c006_down$country_label[fr_up_c006_down$S009_code == cc]),
             " — Periods: FR↑ & C006↓ (Moderates, endpoint in 2010–2020)"),
      x = 0.02, y = 0.98, just = "left",
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")
    )
  }
}
dev.off()

message(sprintf("Total qualifying periods (endpoint in 2010–2020): %d",
                nrow(fr_up_c006_down)))

}
```

```{r Rising Populist Support Graph}
##### ======================= Libraries & Paths ================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(haven)
  library(readr)
  library(countrycode)
  library(gridExtra)
})

ivs_path       <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/Integrated_values_surveys_1981-2022.dta"
fr_codes_path  <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/fr_codes.csv"

out_dir_csv    <- "out"
out_dir_plots  <- "out/plots"
dir.create(out_dir_csv,   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir_plots, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

MIN_WAVES <- 4


##### =========================== Helpers =====================================
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
neg_codes <- -5:-1

extract_year <- function(x){
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    y <- floor(x); y %% 10000
  } else {
    first <- stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d{4}")
    suppressWarnings(as.integer(first))
  }
}

normalize_s009 <- function(x){
  y <- as.character(x)
  y[y %in% c("GB-GBN","UK")] <- "GB"
  y
}

to_num <- function(x) as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(x))

clean_range <- function(x, allow = c(), rng = NULL){
  xi <- to_num(x)
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_
  if (!is.null(rng)) xi[!(xi >= rng[1] & xi <= rng[2])] <- NA_real_
  if (length(allow)) xi[!(xi %in% allow)] <- NA_real_
  xi
}

clean_x047_col <- function(x){
  xi <- to_num(x)
  xi[xi %in% neg_codes] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi == -4] <- NA_real_
  xi[xi <= 0] <- NA_real_
  xi[!(xi >= 1 & xi <= 10)] <- NA_real_
  xi
}

closest_idx <- function(y, target) which.min(abs(y - target))


##### ====================== Load + Minimal Micro Base =========================

needed_cols <- c(
  "S009","S025","E033",
  "C002","C006","G002","G006","E114","D059",
  "E003","E035","E036","E037","E039", "E040",
  "A124_06","X037_01",
  "X047_EVS","X047_WVS","X047WVS",
  "E179_WVS","E179WVS","E179","E181A"
)

ivs <- haven::read_dta(ivs_path, col_select = tidyselect::any_of(needed_cols)) |>
  rename_with(~sub("^X047WVS$", "X047_WVS", .x)) |>
  rename_with(~sub("^E179WVS$", "E179_WVS", .x)) |>
  mutate(
    S009_code   = normalize_s009(S009),
    survey_year = extract_year(S025)
  )

# Cleaned variables
E033_num <- clean_range(ivs$E033)
C002     <- clean_range(ivs$C002)
C006     <- clean_range(ivs$C006)
G002     <- clean_range(ivs$G002, rng = c(1,4))
G006     <- clean_range(ivs$G006, rng = c(1,4))
E114     <- clean_range(ivs$E114)
D059     <- clean_range(ivs$D059)
E003_14  <- clean_range(ivs$E003, rng = c(1,4))
E035_10  <- clean_range(ivs$E035, rng = c(1,10))
E036_10  <- clean_range(ivs$E036, rng = c(1,10))
E037_10  <- clean_range(ivs$E037, rng = c(1,10))
E039_10  <- clean_range(ivs$E039, rng = c(1,10))
E040_10  <- clean_range(ivs$E040, rng = c(1,10))
A124_06  <- clean_range(ivs$A124_06, allow = c(0,1))
X037_01  <- to_num(ivs$X037_01)

# Income source-choice by country-year (prefer EVS when both present)
x047_evs_raw <- to_num(ivs$X047_EVS %||% NA_real_)
x047_wvs_raw <- to_num(ivs$X047_WVS %||% NA_real_)

src_tbl <- tibble(
  S009_code = ivs$S009_code,
  year      = ivs$survey_year,
  evs_miss  = is.na(x047_evs_raw) | x047_evs_raw == -4,
  wvs_miss  = is.na(x047_wvs_raw) | x047_wvs_raw == -4
) |>
  summarise(.by = c(S009_code, year),
            all_evs_miss = all(evs_miss),
            all_wvs_miss = all(wvs_miss)) |>
  mutate(
    X047_source = case_when(
      all_evs_miss & !all_wvs_miss ~ "WVS",
      all_wvs_miss & !all_evs_miss ~ "EVS",
      !all_evs_miss & !all_wvs_miss ~ "EVS",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


##### === Far-right coding from fr_codes.csv (code, year) with per-row window ===
# fr_codes.csv must have columns: code, year

# 1) Read + normalize the code-year table
fr_codes_norm <- readr::read_csv(fr_codes_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(tolower) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    party_code  = as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(code))),
    coding_year = as.integer(year)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(party_code), !is.na(coding_year)) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

# 2) Per-country last survey year
last_year_by_cty <- tibble::tibble(
  S009_code   = ivs$S009_code,
  survey_year = ivs$survey_year
) |>
  dplyr::summarise(.by = S009_code, last_year = max(survey_year, na.rm = TRUE))

# 3) Pull respondent party IDs (match by numeric code only)
wvs_party_raw <- dplyr::coalesce(clean_range(ivs$E179_WVS), clean_range(ivs$E179))
evs_party_raw <- clean_range(ivs$E181A)

resp_party_id <- dplyr::coalesce(wvs_party_raw, evs_party_raw)
party_source  <- dplyr::case_when(
  !is.na(wvs_party_raw) ~ "WVS",
  !is.na(evs_party_raw) ~ "EVS",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

# 4) Build respondents with a per-row window:
#    default = ±5 years; if (country, last survey year) => expanded window
DEFAULT_WINDOW  <- 5L
LASTYEAR_WINDOW <- 10L  # change to a number (e.g., 30L) if you want a cap

respondents <- tibble::tibble(
  obs_id        = seq_len(nrow(ivs)),
  S009_code     = ivs$S009_code,
  survey_year   = ivs$survey_year,
  party_source  = party_source,
  resp_party_id = as.integer(resp_party_id)
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(last_year_by_cty, by = "S009_code") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_last_year = survey_year == last_year,
    window_yrs   = dplyr::if_else(is_last_year, LASTYEAR_WINDOW, DEFAULT_WINDOW)
  )

# 5) Candidate matches; tie-break prefers subsequent/non-past coding year
candidates <- respondents |>
  dplyr::left_join(fr_codes_norm, by = c("resp_party_id" = "party_code")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    year_distance = abs(survey_year - coding_year),
    tie_breaker   = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(coding_year) & coding_year >= survey_year, 0L, 1L)
  )

# 6) Pick nearest within each row’s window
nearest <- candidates |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(coding_year), year_distance <= window_yrs) |>
  dplyr::arrange(obs_id, year_distance, tie_breaker) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(by = "obs_id", n = 1) |>
  dplyr::transmute(obs_id, has_fr_match = TRUE)


# 7) Final per-respondent far-right flag (fixed join logic)
far_right_vote <- respondents |>
  dplyr::left_join(nearest, by = "obs_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    far_right_vote = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(resp_party_id) ~ NA,           # no party given
      !is.na(has_fr_match) ~ TRUE,         # matched within row-specific window
      TRUE                 ~ FALSE
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(obs_id) |>
  dplyr::pull(far_right_vote)

# quick sanity log
message(
  "FR matches overall: ", sum(!is.na(nearest$has_fr_match)),
  " (TRUE: ", sum(nearest$has_fr_match %in% TRUE), ")"
)


##### ================= Build base0 (micro data with cleaned vars) =============
base0 <- tibble(
  S009_code     = ivs$S009_code,
  year          = ivs$survey_year,
  country_label = countrycode(ivs$S009_code, "iso2c", "country.name"),

  E033_num, C002, C006, G002, G006, E114, D059,
  E003_14, E035_10, E036_10, E037_10, E039_10, E040_10,
  A124_06, X037_01,

  X047_EVS_clean = clean_x047_col(ivs$X047_EVS %||% NA_real_),
  X047_WVS_clean = clean_x047_col(ivs$X047_WVS %||% NA_real_),

  far_right_vote = far_right_vote
) |>
  left_join(src_tbl, by = c("S009_code","year")) |>
  mutate(
    X047 = case_when(
      X047_source == "EVS" ~ X047_EVS_clean,
      X047_source == "WVS" ~ X047_WVS_clean,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    is_left_1_3     = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num <= 3,
    is_moderate_4_7 = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 4 & E033_num <= 7,
    is_right_8_10   = !is.na(E033_num) & E033_num >= 8 & E033_num <= 10
  )

##### ================= Parameterized ideology bucket runner ===================
# Put this after `base0` is created (and before your existing plotting chunks).
# It will write outputs for each scheme with a unique suffix.

run_scheme <- function(tag, L_rng, M_rng, R_rng,
                       min_year_for_trend = 2000,
                       lmic_codes = c("BG","GE","ME","RO","RS","TR","UA","IN","ZA"),
                       drop_codes = c("RU","EG"),
                       min_waves_req = NULL) {   # <- new name, default NULL
  
    min_waves_req <- min_waves_req %||% MIN_WAVES

  # 1) Flags for this scheme
  is_left     <- !is.na(base0$E033_num) & base0$E033_num >= L_rng[1] & base0$E033_num <= L_rng[2]
  is_moderate <- !is.na(base0$E033_num) & base0$E033_num >= M_rng[1] & base0$E033_num <= M_rng[2]
  is_right    <- !is.na(base0$E033_num) & base0$E033_num >= R_rng[1] & base0$E033_num <= R_rng[2]

  base_s <- base0 %>%
    mutate(
      is_left     = is_left,
      is_moderate = is_moderate,
      is_right    = is_right
    )

  # Labels and colors for legends/titles
  fmt_rng <- function(r) if (r[1] == r[2]) sprintf("%d", r[1]) else sprintf("%d–%d", r[1], r[2])
  lab_left  <- paste0("Left (",     fmt_rng(L_rng), ")")
  lab_mod   <- paste0("Moderate (", fmt_rng(M_rng), ")")
  lab_right <- paste0("Right (",    fmt_rng(R_rng), ")")

  bucket_colors <- setNames(
  c("blue", "yellow", "red"),
  c(lab_left, lab_mod, lab_right)
)


  # 2) Aggregate to country-year for this scheme
  mod_cy_s <- base_s %>%
    summarise(.by = c(S009_code, country_label, year),
      n_total               = dplyr::n(),
      n_left                = sum(is_left,     na.rm = TRUE),
      n_mod                 = sum(is_moderate, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_right               = sum(is_right,    na.rm = TRUE),

      n_fr_obs_left         = sum(is_left     & !is.na(far_right_vote)),
      n_fr_yes_left         = sum(is_left     & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_fr_obs_mod          = sum(is_moderate & !is.na(far_right_vote)),
      n_fr_yes_mod          = sum(is_moderate & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_fr_obs_right        = sum(is_right    & !is.na(far_right_vote)),
      n_fr_yes_right        = sum(is_right    & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pct_moderate_in_total = ifelse(n_total > 0, 100 * n_mod / n_total, NA_real_),
      pct_fr_among_left     = ifelse(n_fr_obs_left  > 0, 100 * n_fr_yes_left  / n_fr_obs_left,  NA_real_),
      pct_fr_among_moderate = ifelse(n_fr_obs_mod   > 0, 100 * n_fr_yes_mod   / n_fr_obs_mod,   NA_real_),
      pct_fr_among_right    = ifelse(n_fr_obs_right > 0, 100 * n_fr_yes_right / n_fr_obs_right, NA_real_)
    )

  # 3) Keep countries rule for this scheme (uses the scheme’s moderate bucket)
  keep_countries_s <- mod_cy_s %>%
    summarise(.by = S009_code,
      n_years = dplyr::n_distinct(year),
      any_fr  = any(pct_fr_among_moderate > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_years >= min_waves_req, any_fr) %>%   # <- use min_waves_req
    dplyr::pull(S009_code)
  
  message(sprintf("[%s] Countries retained: %d (of %d meeting waves+FR>0).",
                  tag, length(keep_countries_s), length(unique(mod_cy_s$S009_code))))

  # 4) Slope check (2010 vs 2020) for this scheme
  slope_10_20_s <- mod_cy_s %>%
    filter(S009_code %in% keep_countries_s) %>%
    arrange(S009_code, year) %>%
    summarise(.by = c(S009_code, country_label),
      i10 = closest_idx(year, 2010),
      i20 = closest_idx(year, 2020),

      year_10 = year[i10],
      year_20 = year[i20],

      frL_10  = pct_fr_among_left[i10],
      frL_20  = pct_fr_among_left[i20],
      frM_10  = pct_fr_among_moderate[i10],
      frM_20  = pct_fr_among_moderate[i20],
      frR_10  = pct_fr_among_right[i10],
      frR_20  = pct_fr_among_right[i20]
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      dt_years = year_20 - year_10,
      slope_left      = ifelse(dt_years > 0, (frL_20 - frL_10) / dt_years, NA_real_),
      slope_moderate  = ifelse(dt_years > 0, (frM_20 - frM_10) / dt_years, NA_real_),
      slope_right     = ifelse(dt_years > 0, (frR_20 - frR_10) / dt_years, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(slope_left) | !is.na(slope_moderate) | !is.na(slope_right))

  readr::write_csv(slope_10_20_s,
    file.path(out_dir_csv, sprintf("fr_support_slopes_2010to2020_%s.csv", tag))
  )

  slope_long_s <- slope_10_20_s %>%
    select(S009_code, country_label, slope_left, slope_moderate, slope_right) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(slope_left, slope_moderate, slope_right),
                 names_to = "bucket", values_to = "slope_pp_per_year") %>%
    mutate(bucket = case_when(
      bucket == "slope_left"     ~ lab_left,
      bucket == "slope_moderate" ~ lab_mod,
      bucket == "slope_right"    ~ lab_right,
      TRUE ~ bucket
    ))

  pdf(file.path(out_dir_plots, sprintf("slope_scatter_2010to2020_%s.pdf", tag)),
      width = 11, height = 6)
  print(
    ggplot(slope_long_s,
           aes(x = reorder(country_label, slope_pp_per_year, FUN = median, na.rm = TRUE),
               y = slope_pp_per_year, color = bucket)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(values = bucket_colors) +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("Rise in far-right support per year, ~2010→~2020 (%s)", tag),
        subtitle = "Slope = (FR%_2020 − FR%_2010) / (year_2020 − year_2010)",
        x = "Country", y = "Slope (pp per year)", color = "Ideology bucket"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10))
  )
  dev.off()

  # 5) “All countries” trend since min_year_for_trend
  mod_long_2000_s <- mod_cy_s %>%
    filter(S009_code %in% keep_countries_s, year >= min_year_for_trend) %>%
    select(S009_code, country_label, year,
           pct_fr_among_left, pct_fr_among_moderate, pct_fr_among_right,
           n_fr_obs_left, n_fr_obs_mod, n_fr_obs_right) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(pct_fr_among_left, pct_fr_among_moderate, pct_fr_among_right),
      names_to = "bucket_raw", values_to = "fr_pct"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      bucket = recode(bucket_raw,
                      pct_fr_among_left     = lab_left,
                      pct_fr_among_moderate = lab_mod,
                      pct_fr_among_right    = lab_right),
      n_obs = case_when(
        bucket == lab_left  ~ n_fr_obs_left,
        bucket == lab_mod   ~ n_fr_obs_mod,
        bucket == lab_right ~ n_fr_obs_right
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(fr_pct)) %>%
    mutate(point_size = pmin(n_obs, 1500))

  pdf(file.path(out_dir_plots, sprintf("all_countries_FRshare_since%d_%s.pdf",
                                       min_year_for_trend, tag)),
      width = 11, height = 7)
  print(
    ggplot(mod_long_2000_s, aes(x = year, y = fr_pct, color = bucket)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.35, aes(size = point_size)) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) +
      scale_color_manual(values = bucket_colors) +
      scale_size(range = c(1.2, 4.5), guide = "none") +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("Far-right vote share by ideology since %d (%s)",
                        min_year_for_trend, tag),
        subtitle = "Each point is a country–year; lines are linear best fits by ideology bucket",
        x = "Year", y = "Far-right vote share (%)", color = "Ideology"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
            legend.position = "bottom")
  )
  dev.off()

  # 6) Grouped version: LMIC vs Advanced (drop Russia & Egypt)
  mod_long_groups_s <- mod_cy_s %>%
    filter(S009_code %in% keep_countries_s,
           !(S009_code %in% drop_codes),
           year >= min_year_for_trend) %>%
    select(S009_code, country_label, year,
           pct_fr_among_left, pct_fr_among_moderate, pct_fr_among_right,
           n_fr_obs_left, n_fr_obs_mod, n_fr_obs_right) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(pct_fr_among_left, pct_fr_among_moderate, pct_fr_among_right),
      names_to = "bucket_raw", values_to = "fr_pct"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      bucket = recode(bucket_raw,
                      pct_fr_among_left     = lab_left,
                      pct_fr_among_moderate = lab_mod,
                      pct_fr_among_right    = lab_right),
      n_obs = case_when(
        bucket == lab_left  ~ n_fr_obs_left,
        bucket == lab_mod   ~ n_fr_obs_mod,
        bucket == lab_right ~ n_fr_obs_right
      ),
      country_group = if_else(S009_code %in% lmic_codes,
                              "Low & Middle-Income Countries",
                              "Advanced Industrialized Democracies")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(fr_pct)) %>%
    mutate(point_size = pmin(n_obs, 1500))

  pdf(file.path(out_dir_plots, sprintf("FRshare_since%d_by_group_%s.pdf",
                                       min_year_for_trend, tag)),
      width = 12, height = 7.5)
  print(
    ggplot(mod_long_groups_s, aes(x = year, y = fr_pct, color = bucket)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.35, aes(size = point_size)) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) +
      scale_color_manual(values = bucket_colors) +
      scale_size(range = c(1.2, 4.5), guide = "none") +
      facet_wrap(~ country_group) +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("Far-right vote share by ideology since %d (%s)",
                        min_year_for_trend, tag),
        subtitle = "Countries split into LMIC vs Advanced (Russia & Egypt excluded)",
        x = "Year", y = "Far-right vote share (%)", color = "Ideology"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
            legend.position = "bottom",
            strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
  )
  dev.off()

  invisible(list(
    mod_cy = mod_cy_s,
    keep_countries = keep_countries_s,
    slopes = slope_10_20_s
  ))
}

mod_cy <- base0 |>
  summarise(.by = c(S009_code, country_label, year),
    n_total               = dplyr::n(),
    n_moderate            = sum(is_moderate_4_7, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_moderate_in_total = ifelse(n_total > 0, 100 * n_moderate / n_total, NA_real_),

    n_fr_obs_left  = sum(is_left_1_3     & !is.na(far_right_vote)),
    n_fr_yes_left  = sum(is_left_1_3     & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fr_obs_mod   = sum(is_moderate_4_7 & !is.na(far_right_vote)),
    n_fr_yes_mod   = sum(is_moderate_4_7 & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fr_obs_right = sum(is_right_8_10   & !is.na(far_right_vote)),
    n_fr_yes_right = sum(is_right_8_10   & far_right_vote %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_fr_among_left     = ifelse(n_fr_obs_left  > 0, 100 * n_fr_yes_left  / n_fr_obs_left,  NA_real_),
    pct_fr_among_moderate = ifelse(n_fr_obs_mod   > 0, 100 * n_fr_yes_mod   / n_fr_obs_mod,   NA_real_),
    pct_fr_among_right    = ifelse(n_fr_obs_right > 0, 100 * n_fr_yes_right / n_fr_obs_right, NA_real_)
  )

keep_countries_base <- mod_cy |>
  summarise(.by = S009_code,
            n_years = dplyr::n_distinct(year),
            any_fr  = any(pct_fr_among_moderate > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  filter(n_years >= MIN_WAVES, any_fr) |>
  pull(S009_code)
```

```{r Are Moderates Moderate?}
##### ===== CHUNK 2: Middle-of-distribution shares by ideology & country-year ====

# We work only with kept countries
mid_base <- base0 %>% 
  filter(S009_code %in% keep_countries) %>% 
  select(
    S009_code, country_label, year,
    E033_num,
    E035_10, E036_10, E037_10, E039_10, E040_10,
    is_left_1_3, is_moderate_4_7, is_right_8_10
  )

# Long form for the five 1–10 items
mid_items <- mid_base %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(E035_10, E036_10, E037_10, E039_10, E040_10),
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# Country-year-item means and SDs across all respondents
item_stats <- mid_items %>%
  group_by(S009_code, country_label, year, item) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_item = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_item   = stats::sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmiss = sum(!is.na(value)),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

# Join back and flag "middle" as within ±1 SD of the mean
mid_items <- mid_items %>%
  left_join(item_stats,
                   by = c("S009_code", "country_label", "year", "item")) %>%
  mutate(
    is_middle = case_when(
      is.na(value) ~ NA_integer_,
      is.na(mean_item) | is.na(sd_item) ~ NA_integer_,
      sd_item <= 0 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ ifelse(
        value >= mean_item - sd_item &
        value <= mean_item + sd_item,
        1L, 0L
      )
    )
  )

# Helper to build a table for one ideology bucket
build_mid_table <- function(data, bucket_var) {
  data %>%
    filter(.data[[bucket_var]] %in% TRUE) %>%
    group_by(S009_code, country_label, year, item) %>%
    summarise(
      n_bucket = sum(!is.na(value)),
      n_mid    = sum(is_middle == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_mid  = ifelse(n_bucket > 0, 100 * n_mid / n_bucket, NA_real_),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = item,
      values_from = pct_mid
    ) %>%
    rename(
      pct_mid_E035 = E035_10,
      pct_mid_E036 = E036_10,
      pct_mid_E037 = E037_10,
      pct_mid_E039 = E039_10,
      pct_mid_E040 = E040_10
    ) %>%
    arrange(country_label, year)
}

# Build three tables: moderates, right, left
mid_table_moderate <- build_mid_table(mid_items, "is_moderate_4_7")
mid_table_right    <- build_mid_table(mid_items, "is_right_8_10")
mid_table_left     <- build_mid_table(mid_items, "is_left_1_3")

# Write CSVs
write_csv(
  mid_table_moderate,
  file.path(out_dir_csv, "midshare_by_country_year_moderates.csv")
)
write_csv(
  mid_table_right,
  file.path(out_dir_csv, "midshare_by_country_year_right.csv")
)
write_csv(
  mid_table_left,
  file.path(out_dir_csv, "midshare_by_country_year_left.csv")
)

# Nicely rounded versions for display
mid_table_moderate_disp <- mid_table_moderate %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("pct_mid_"),
                              ~ round(.x, 1)))
mid_table_right_disp <- mid_table_right %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("pct_mid_"),
                              ~ round(.x, 1)))
mid_table_left_disp <- mid_table_left %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("pct_mid_"),
                              ~ round(.x, 1)))

# Save as table images
png(file.path(out_dir_plots, "midshare_by_country_year_moderates.png"),
    width = 1600, height = 900, res = 150)
gridExtra::grid.table(mid_table_moderate_disp)
dev.off()

png(file.path(out_dir_plots, "midshare_by_country_year_right.png"),
    width = 1600, height = 900, res = 150)

png(file.path(out_dir_plots, "midshare_by_country_year_left.png"),
    width = 1600, height = 900, res = 150)

dev.off()

message("CHUNK 2 completed: middle-of-distribution shares by ideology and country-year saved to CSV and PNG.")

##### ===== CHUNK 2b: Collapse to one row per country-year (moderates) =====

collapse_mid_table <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(S009_code, country_label, year) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::starts_with("pct_mid_"),
        ~ {
          u <- unique(stats::na.omit(.x))
          if (length(u) == 0L) NA_real_ else u[1]
        }
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(country_label, year)
}

# Apply to moderates
mid_table_moderate_collapsed <- collapse_mid_table(mid_table_moderate)

# Optional: apply to right and left too
mid_table_right_collapsed    <- collapse_mid_table(mid_table_right)
mid_table_left_collapsed     <- collapse_mid_table(mid_table_left)

# Write collapsed CSVs
readr::write_csv(
  mid_table_moderate_collapsed,
  file.path(out_dir_csv, "midshare_by_country_year_moderates_collapsed.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  mid_table_right_collapsed,
  file.path(out_dir_csv, "midshare_by_country_year_right_collapsed.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  mid_table_left_collapsed,
  file.path(out_dir_csv, "midshare_by_country_year_left_collapsed.csv")
)
```

```{r Global Moderate Scale (Controlled)}
##### ===== Correlations: E033 vs E040 controlling for subjective income (X047) =====

# Helper: partial correlation r_xy.z using Pearson correlations
pcor_xy_z <- function(x, y, z) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  y <- as.numeric(y)
  z <- as.numeric(z)

  # Keep rows where all three are observed
  ok <- !(is.na(x) | is.na(y) | is.na(z))
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)

  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]; z <- z[ok]

  r_xy <- suppressWarnings(cor(x, y, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman"))
  r_xz <- suppressWarnings(cor(x, z, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman"))
  r_yz <- suppressWarnings(cor(y, z, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman"))

  if (any(is.na(c(r_xy, r_xz, r_yz)))) return(NA_real_)

  denom <- sqrt((1 - r_xz^2) * (1 - r_yz^2))
  if (!is.finite(denom) || denom <= 0) return(NA_real_)

  (r_xy - r_xz * r_yz) / denom
}

# 1) Build row-level flags and subjective income control
corr_base_x047 <- base0 %>%
  mutate(
    # use cleaned E040, 1–10, created earlier as E040_10
    E040_num = E040_10,

    e040_conservative = !is.na(E040_num) & E040_num >= 1 & E040_num <= 3,
    e040_centrist     = !is.na(E040_num) & E040_num >= 4 & E040_num <= 7,
    e040_progressive  = !is.na(E040_num) & E040_num >= 8 & E040_num <= 10,

    # subjective income: X047 (already combined EVS/WVS and cleaned)
    subj_income = X047
  ) %>%
  # restrict to filtered countries and non-missing subjective income
  dplyr::filter(
    S009_code %in% keep_countries,
    !is.na(subj_income)
  )

# 2) Country-level partial correlations
corr_by_cty_x047 <- corr_base_x047 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(country_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    pcor_right_conservative = pcor_xy_z(is_right_8_10,    e040_conservative, subj_income),
    pcor_moderate_centrist  = pcor_xy_z(is_moderate_4_7,  e040_centrist,     subj_income),
    pcor_left_progressive   = pcor_xy_z(is_left_1_3,      e040_progressive,  subj_income),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(country_label) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Right ↔ Conservative (E040 1–3)` = round(pcor_right_conservative, 3),
    `Moderate ↔ Centrist (E040 4–7)`  = round(pcor_moderate_centrist, 3),
    `Left ↔ Progressive (E040 8–10)`  = round(pcor_left_progressive, 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Country = country_label,
    `Right ↔ Conservative (E040 1–3)`,
    `Moderate ↔ Centrist (E040 4–7)`,
    `Left ↔ Progressive (E040 8–10)`
  )

# 3) Save as a table image
tbl_grob_x047 <- gridExtra::tableGrob(corr_by_cty_x047, rows = NULL)

png_path_x047 <- file.path(
  out_dir_plots,
  "corr_E033_E040_buckets_by_country_control_X047.png"
)

png_width_px  <- 2200
png_height_px <- max(2000, 60 * (nrow(corr_by_cty_x047) + 2))

png(filename = png_path_x047, width = png_width_px, height = png_height_px, res = 200)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(tbl_grob_x047)
dev.off()
```

```{r India2012_E036_z_by_E033, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
##### ===== India 2012: z-score E036, then mean(z) by E033 increment =====

# 1) Restrict to India 2012 + keep only needed vars
in12 <- base0 %>%
  dplyr::filter(S009_code == "IN", year == 2012) %>%
  dplyr::select(S009_code, country_label, year, E033_num, E036_10)

# 2) Compute India-2012 mean/sd for E036 (all available responses)
mu_e036 <- mean(in12$E036_10, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_e036 <- stats::sd(in12$E036_10, na.rm = TRUE)

message(sprintf("India 2012: E036 mean = %.4f, sd = %.4f", mu_e036, sd_e036))

if (!is.finite(sd_e036) || sd_e036 <= 0) {
  stop("Cannot compute z-scores: E036 sd in India 2012 is missing or non-positive.")
}

# 3) Z-score at individual level; then mean(z) by each E033 increment (1..10)
in12_by_e033 <- in12 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    z_E036 = (E036_10 - mu_e036) / sd_e036
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(E033_num), !is.na(z_E036)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(E033_num) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_z_E036 = mean(z_E036, na.rm = TRUE),
    n           = dplyr::n(),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(E033_num)

# Optional: save the aggregated series
readr::write_csv(
  in12_by_e033,
  file.path(out_dir_csv, "india_2012_mean_zE036_by_E033_increment.csv")
)

# 4) Plot mean z-score by ideology increment
p_in12 <- ggplot(in12_by_e033, aes(x = E033_num, y = mean_z_E036)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10, limits = c(1, 10)) +
  scale_size(range = c(2.2, 6), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "India (2012): Mean standardized E036 by ideology (E033)",
    subtitle = "E036 z-scored within India-2012 across all available respondents; point size ∝ N in bin",
    x = "Ideology self-placement (E033, 1–10)",
    y = "Mean z-score of E036"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Save plot
pdf_path <- file.path(out_dir_plots, "india_2012_mean_zE036_by_E033_increment.pdf")
png_path <- file.path(out_dir_plots, "india_2012_mean_zE036_by_E033_increment.png")

ggsave(pdf_path, p_in12, width = 8.5, height = 5.2)
ggsave(png_path, p_in12, width = 8.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 200)

p_in12
message("Saved: ", pdf_path)
message("Saved: ", png_path)
```

```{r IndiaPooledAllYears_E040_z_by_E033, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
in_pool <- base0 %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    S009_code == "IN",
    !is.na(year),
    year != 2023
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(country_label, year, E033_num, E040_10)

# 2) Compute pooled mean/sd for E040 across all included years
mu_e040_pool <- mean(in_pool$E040_10, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_e040_pool <- stats::sd(in_pool$E040_10, na.rm = TRUE)

message(sprintf("India pooled (all years except 2023): E040 mean = %.4f, sd = %.4f",
                mu_e040_pool, sd_e040_pool))

if (!is.finite(sd_e040_pool) || sd_e040_pool <= 0) {
  stop("Cannot compute pooled z-scores: pooled E040 sd is missing or non-positive.")
}

# 3) Z-score each respondent relative to pooled India distribution,
#    then mean(z) by E033 increment (pooled)
in_pool_by_e033 <- in_pool %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    z_E040 = (E040_10 - mu_e040_pool) / sd_e040_pool
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(E033_num), !is.na(z_E040)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(E033_num) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_z_E040 = mean(z_E040, na.rm = TRUE),
    n           = dplyr::n(),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(E033_num)

# Save the aggregated series
readr::write_csv(
  in_pool_by_e033,
  file.path(out_dir_csv, "india_pooled_all_years_mean_zE040_by_E033_increment.csv")
)

# 4) Plot pooled mean z-score by ideology increment
p_in_pool <- ggplot(in_pool_by_e033, aes(x = E033_num, y = mean_z_E040)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10, limits = c(1, 10)) +
  scale_size(range = c(2.2, 6), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "India (pooled years, excluding 2023): Mean standardized E040 by ideology (E033)",
    subtitle = "E040 z-scored on pooled India distribution; point size ∝ N in ideology bin",
    x = "Ideology self-placement (E033, 1–10)",
    y = "Mean z-score of E040"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Save plot
pdf_path <- file.path(out_dir_plots, "india_pooled_all_years_mean_zE040_by_E033_increment.pdf")
png_path <- file.path(out_dir_plots, "india_pooled_all_years_mean_zE040_by_E033_increment.png")

ggsave(pdf_path, p_in_pool, width = 8.5, height = 5.2)
ggsave(png_path, p_in_pool, width = 8.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 200)

p_in_pool
message("Saved: ", pdf_path)
message("Saved: ", png_path)
```
