```{r FDI Exposure}
# --- Setup ----
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "readxl", "sf", "stringi"))  # if needed

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(stringi)

# Paths
fdi_dir   <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/FDI Markets India"
city_csv  <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data/city_counts.csv"
shp_all   <- "~/Downloads/ac_all_final_april_2012/AC_All_Final.shp"          # old polygons
shp_india <- "~/Downloads/maps-master/assembly-constituencies/India_AC.shp"  # new polygons

# --- Helpers ----

# Read a file, skipping the first two rows, supporting CSV/TSV/Excel
read_skipping_two <- function(path) {
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))
  if (ext %in% c("csv")) {
    suppressMessages(readr::read_csv(path, skip = 2, show_col_types = FALSE))
  } else if (ext %in% c("tsv", "tab")) {
    suppressMessages(readr::read_tsv(path, skip = 2, show_col_types = FALSE))
  } else if (ext %in% c("xls", "xlsx")) {
    suppressMessages(readxl::read_excel(path, skip = 2))
  } else {
    stop(sprintf("Unsupported file type for: %s", path))
  }
}

# Strong normalization for joining city names
norm_city <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stri_replace_all_regex("\\p{Cf}", "") %>%                        # remove invisible format chars
    str_replace_all("\\u00A0", " ") %>%                              # NBSP -> space
    str_replace_all("[\u2010\u2011\u2012\u2013\u2014]", "-") %>%     # dashes -> hyphen
    str_replace_all("[\u2018\u2019\u02BC]", "'") %>%                 # curly apostrophes -> '
    str_replace_all("[\u201C\u201D]", "\"") %>%                      # curly quotes -> "
    stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") %>%                             # accents -> ASCII
    tolower() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", " ") %>%                           # non-alnum -> space
    str_trim() %>%
    str_squish()
}

# Try to pick an assembly constituency field from a polygon layer
pick_ac_name_field <- function(gdf) {
  nms <- names(gdf)
  cands <- c("AC_NAME")  # primary field to use in your data
  hit <- nms[tolower(nms) %in% tolower(cands)]
  if (length(hit) > 0) return(hit[1])
  # fallbacks if needed
  regex_hits <- nms[stringr::str_detect(tolower(nms), "(assembly|constituency|ac).*name|^ac(_|$)")]
  if (length(regex_hits) > 0) return(regex_hits[1])
  fallback <- nms[stringr::str_detect(tolower(nms), "const|assembly|ac")]
  if (length(fallback) > 0) return(fallback[1])
  stop("Could not find an assembly constituency name field in a shapefile.")
}

# Spatial join with CRS handling
join_points_to_polys <- function(points_sf, polys_sf) {
  stopifnot(!is.na(sf::st_crs(polys_sf)))
  pts <- sf::st_transform(points_sf, sf::st_crs(polys_sf))
  sf::st_join(pts, polys_sf, left = TRUE, largest = TRUE)
}

# --- 1) Merge FDI tables, removing first two rows from each ----

if (!dir.exists(fdi_dir)) {
  stop(sprintf("Input folder not found: '%s'", fdi_dir))
}

files <- list.files(
  fdi_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE,
  pattern = "\\.(csv|tsv|tab|xls|xlsx)$", ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop(sprintf("No CSV/TSV/Excel files found in '%s'", fdi_dir))
}

tables <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  df <- read_skipping_two(f)
  if (!"Destination City" %in% names(df)) {
    stop(sprintf("Column 'Destination City' not found in file: %s", basename(f)))
  }
  df %>%
    mutate(destination_city_norm = norm_city(`Destination City`))
})

merged <- dplyr::bind_rows(tables)

# --- 2) Add lat/long from city_counts.csv (key: destination_city_norm), audit, coerce, guard ----

if (!file.exists(city_csv)) {
  stop(sprintf("city_counts.csv not found at: %s", city_csv))
}

city_counts <- readr::read_csv(city_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    destination_city_norm = norm_city(destination_city_norm),
    lat  = readr::parse_number(lat),
    long = readr::parse_number(long)
  ) %>%
  distinct(destination_city_norm, lat, long)

required_cols <- c("destination_city_norm", "lat", "long")
missing_req <- setdiff(required_cols, names(city_counts))
if (length(missing_req) > 0) {
  stop(sprintf("city_counts.csv missing column(s): %s", paste(missing_req, collapse = ", ")))
}

# Audit: which cities don’t match after normalization
unmatched <- merged %>%
  anti_join(city_counts, by = "destination_city_norm") %>%
  count(`Destination City`, destination_city_norm, sort = TRUE)

message("Unmatched unique city strings: ", nrow(unmatched))
if (nrow(unmatched) > 0) {
  unmatched %>%
    mutate(
      dest_city_escaped = stringi::stri_escape_unicode(`Destination City`),
      norm_escaped      = stringi::stri_escape_unicode(destination_city_norm)
    ) %>%
    slice_head(n = 30) %>%
    select(n, `Destination City`, dest_city_escaped, destination_city_norm, norm_escaped) %>%
    print(n = 30)
}

merged2 <- merged %>%
  left_join(city_counts, by = "destination_city_norm") %>%
  mutate(
    # keep as numeric; coerce if needed
    lat  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(lat)),
    long = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(long)),
    # guard against non-finite & out-of-bounds values (rough India bounds)
    lat  = if_else(is.finite(lat)  & lat  >= 6  & lat  <= 37, lat,  NA_real_),
    long = if_else(is.finite(long) & long >= 68 & long <= 98, long, NA_real_)
  )


n_missing_coords <- sum(!is.finite(merged2$lat) | !is.finite(merged2$long))
if (n_missing_coords > 0) {
  warning(sprintf("There are %d rows without usable lat/long after the join.", n_missing_coords))
}

# --- 3) Points from lat/long (WGS84) ----
pts_sf <- merged2 %>%
  filter(is.finite(lat), is.finite(long)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

# --- 4) Spatial lookup against AC_All_Final.shp -> old_ac ----
if (!file.exists(shp_all)) {
  stop(sprintf("Shapefile not found: %s", shp_all))
}
ac_all <- st_read(shp_all, quiet = TRUE)  # 'geometry' column in your data
if (is.na(st_crs(ac_all))) stop("AC_All_Final.shp has no CRS; set a valid CRS before running.")

ac_all_name_col <- pick_ac_name_field(ac_all)

pts_all <- join_points_to_polys(pts_sf, ac_all) %>%
  mutate(old_ac = .data[[ac_all_name_col]]) %>%
  # keep only merged attributes + geometry + old_ac to avoid collisions
  select(all_of(intersect(names(.), c(names(merged2), "geometry", "old_ac"))))

# --- 5) Spatial lookup against India_AC.shp -> new_ac ----
if (!file.exists(shp_india)) {
  stop(sprintf("Shapefile not found: %s", shp_india))
}
india_ac <- st_read(shp_india, quiet = TRUE)  # 'geometry' column in your data
if (is.na(st_crs(india_ac))) stop("India_AC.shp has no CRS; set a valid CRS before running.")

india_ac_name_col <- pick_ac_name_field(india_ac)

pts_ind <- join_points_to_polys(pts_sf, india_ac) %>%
  mutate(new_ac = .data[[india_ac_name_col]]) %>%
  select(all_of(intersect(names(.), c(names(merged2), "geometry", "new_ac"))))

# --- 6) Attach old_ac and new_ac back to full merged table (including rows with missing coords) ----
# Create stable ids for rows with coordinates
pts_sf_with_id <- pts_sf %>% mutate(.row_id = dplyr::row_number())

# Map .row_id back to merged2 rows that had coords
merged_with_id <- merged2 %>%
  mutate(.has_coords = is.finite(lat) & is.finite(long),
         .row_id = if_else(.has_coords, cumsum(.has_coords), NA_integer_))

old_names <- pts_all %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(.row_id = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  select(.row_id, old_ac)

new_names <- pts_ind %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(.row_id = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  select(.row_id, new_ac)

ac_names <- old_names %>%
  full_join(new_names, by = ".row_id")

final_df <- merged_with_id %>%
  left_join(ac_names, by = ".row_id") %>%
  select(-.row_id, -.has_coords)

# --- 7) Write outputs ----
readr::write_csv(final_df, "FDI_merged_with_old_new_AC.csv")

# Also write points with attributes to a GeoPackage
pts_out <- pts_sf_with_id %>%
  left_join(ac_names, by = ".row_id") %>%
  select(-.row_id)

st_write(pts_out, "FDI_points_with_old_new_AC.gpkg",
         layer = "fdi_points", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

message("Done. Files written:\n - FDI_merged_with_old_new_AC.csv\n - FDI_points_with_old_new_AC.gpkg (layer: fdi_points)")

#######

# --- Setup ----
# install.packages(c("tidyverse","lubridate","readr"))  # if needed
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)

# ---- Paths (adjust if needed) ----
fdi_csv  <- "~/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/FDI_merged_with_old_new_AC.csv"
tcpd_csv <- "~/DVM_R/EP&E-492/data/Lok_Dhaba/TCPD_AE_All_States_2024-1-25.csv"

# Optional extra outputs for city-based summaries
out_counts_city  <- "FDI_counts_by_city_with_periods.csv"
out_changes_city <- "FDI_city_change_0409_to_0914.csv"

# ---- 1) Read & periodize FDI ----
fdi <- readr::read_csv(fdi_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    project_date = as.Date(substr(`Project Date`, 1, 10)),
    period = case_when(
      project_date <  as.Date("2004-05-01") ~ "pre_2004_05",
      project_date >= as.Date("2004-05-01") & project_date < as.Date("2009-05-01") ~ "p2004_2009",
      project_date >= as.Date("2009-05-01") & project_date < as.Date("2014-05-01") ~ "p2009_2014",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# A) CITY-LEVEL COUNTS (destination city) + CHANGE 04–09 -> 09–14
# ============================================================

# human-readable city label per normalized key
city_labels <- fdi %>%
  filter(!is.na(destination_city_norm)) %>%
  count(destination_city_norm, `Destination City`, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(destination_city_norm) %>%
  slice_max(n, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(destination_city_norm, Destination_City_label = `Destination City`)

# tall counts: city x period
city_counts_long <- fdi %>%
  filter(!is.na(period), !is.na(destination_city_norm)) %>%
  count(destination_city_norm, period, name = "projects") %>%
  left_join(city_labels, by = "destination_city_norm")

# wide + change
city_counts_wide <- city_counts_long %>%
  select(destination_city_norm, Destination_City_label, period, projects) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = projects, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    p2004_2009 = coalesce(p2004_2009, 0L),
    p2009_2014 = coalesce(p2009_2014, 0L),
    fdi_change_0409_to_0914 = p2009_2014 - p2004_2009
  )

# write city-level outputs
write_csv(city_counts_long,  out_counts_city)
write_csv(city_counts_wide,  out_changes_city)

# ============================================================
# B) CONSTITUENCY-LEVEL: include BOTH old_ac and new_ac, and compute change
#     Output file: FDI_counts_by_newAC_with_changes.csv
#     Columns: ac_kind ∈ {"old_ac","new_ac"}, ac_name, period counts, change
# ============================================================

# Tall: (ac_kind, ac_name, period) counts
fdi_counts_long_ac <- fdi %>%
  filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(old_ac, new_ac),
    names_to = "ac_kind",
    values_to = "ac_name"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ac_name)) %>%
  count(ac_kind, ac_name, period, name = "projects")

# Wide + change for BOTH maps
fdi_counts_w <- fdi_counts_long_ac %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = period, values_from = projects, values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p2004_2009 = coalesce(p2004_2009, 0L),
    p2009_2014 = coalesce(p2009_2014, 0L),
    fdi_change_0409_to_0914 = p2009_2014 - p2004_2009
  )

# This file now has BOTH old & new ACs, marked by ac_kind
readr::write_csv(fdi_counts_w, "FDI_counts_by_newAC_with_changes.csv")

# ============================================================
# C) TCPD winners-only + BJP vote share (from full TCPD)
#     Note: your file uses Year and Vote_Share_Percentage/Party
# ============================================================
tcpd_full <- readr::read_csv(tcpd_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

tcpd_winners <- tcpd_full %>%
  filter(Position == 1) %>%
  select(Constituency_Name, Year, Position, Vote_Share_Percentage, Party)

bjp_share <- tcpd_full %>%
  filter(Party == "BJP") %>%
  group_by(Constituency_Name, Year) %>%
  summarise(BJP_vote_share = sum(Vote_Share_Percentage, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

tcpd_win_plus_bjp <- tcpd_winners %>%
  left_join(bjp_share, by = c("Constituency_Name", "Year"))

# Keep assembly elections only if column exists
if ("Election_Type" %in% names(tcpd_full)) {
  tcpd_win_plus_bjp <- tcpd_win_plus_bjp %>%
    left_join(
      tcpd_full %>% distinct(Constituency_Name, Year, Election_Type),
      by = c("Constituency_Name", "Year")
    ) %>%
    filter(is.na(Election_Type) | grepl("Assembly", Election_Type))
}

# ============================================================
# D) BJP vote share change: 2014 - 2009, tag with ac_kind, and NORMALIZE NAMES
#     (Both 2009 & 2014 are on the NEW map => ac_kind = "new_ac")
# ============================================================
library(stringi)

normalize_const <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") %>%       # accents -> ASCII
    str_replace_all("\\u00A0", " ") %>%         # NBSP -> space
    str_replace_all("\\(", " ") %>%             # drop parens content markers
    str_replace_all("\\)", " ") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\bSC\\b|\\bST\\b|\\bGEN\\b|\\bSU\\b", " ") %>%
    str_replace_all("&", " and ") %>%
    str_replace_all("[\\-_/]", " ") %>%         # hyphens/underscores/slashes -> space
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9 ]", " ") %>%   # strip punctuation
    str_squish() %>%
    tolower()
}

bjp_change <- tcpd_win_plus_bjp %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2009, 2014)) %>%
  select(Constituency_Name, Year, BJP_vote_share) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Year,
    values_from = BJP_vote_share,
    names_prefix = "bjp_vs_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bjp_vs_change_2009_2014 = bjp_vs_2014 - bjp_vs_2009,
    ac_kind = "new_ac",
    ac_name_norm = normalize_const(Constituency_Name)
  )

# Quick audit of missing 2009/2014 values (optional)
message("bjp_change rows: ", nrow(bjp_change),
        " | with non-NA change: ", sum(is.finite(bjp_change$bjp_vs_change_2009_2014)))

# ============================================================
# E) Build FDI join table for BOTH ac kinds and NORMALIZE NAMES
#     Join key is (ac_kind, ac_name_norm)
# ============================================================
fdi_for_join <- fdi_counts_w %>%
  mutate(ac_name_norm = normalize_const(ac_name)) %>%
  select(ac_kind, ac_name, ac_name_norm, p2004_2009, p2009_2014, fdi_change_0409_to_0914)

# Audit: how many bjp_change names still fail to match on normalized key?
unmatched_after_norm <- bjp_change %>%
  select(ac_kind, ac_name_norm) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  anti_join(fdi_for_join %>% select(ac_kind, ac_name_norm) %>% distinct(),
            by = c("ac_kind","ac_name_norm"))
message("Unmatched after normalization (distinct): ", nrow(unmatched_after_norm))

# OPTIONAL: uncomment to peek at a few
# print(head(unmatched_after_norm$ac_name_norm, 20))

# ============================================================
# F) Final join and regression
# ============================================================
analysis_df <- bjp_change %>%
  left_join(fdi_for_join, by = c("ac_kind", "ac_name_norm"))

model_df <- analysis_df %>%
  filter(is.finite(bjp_vs_change_2009_2014), is.finite(fdi_change_0409_to_0914))

message("Rows in model_df (post-normalization): ", nrow(model_df))

model <- lm(bjp_vs_change_2009_2014 ~ fdi_change_0409_to_0914, data = model_df)

cat("\n=== Regression summary (normalized join) ===\n")
print(summary(model))


```

```{r Merging Migration Data}
## ------------------------------------------------------------------
## Setup
## ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Root directory that contains "2001" and "2011"
root_dir <- "/Users/Daevan/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data"

dir_2001 <- file.path(root_dir, "/Migration/2001")
dir_2011 <- file.path(root_dir, "/Migration/2011")
out_dir  <- file.path(root_dir, "/Migration/Delta")

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir)
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------------
## Helper: clean Area names so 2001 and 2011 match
## ------------------------------------------------------------------
clean_area <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  # Remove leading "STATE - " or "District - " (case insensitive)
  x <- gsub("(?i)^state\\s*-\\s*", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)^district\\s*-\\s*", "", x, perl = TRUE)

  # Remove trailing codes like " 01", " 02", "(01)", "(02)"
  x <- gsub("\\s*\\(?0*[0-9]{1,2}\\)?$", "", x)

  x <- trimws(x)
  toupper(x)
}

## Helper: standardize key string columns (trim + upper)
std_key <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  toupper(trimws(x))
}

## Helper: convert numeric-looking columns (with commas) to numeric
to_numeric_cols <- function(df, exclude = character()) {
  cols <- setdiff(names(df), exclude)
  for (nm in cols) {
    # Try to convert only if it is not obviously non numeric
    if (is.character(df[[nm]])) {
      tmp <- gsub(",", "", df[[nm]])
      suppressWarnings(num <- as.numeric(tmp))
      # If at least some values become numeric, keep them
      if (sum(!is.na(num)) > 0) {
        df[[nm]] <- num
      }
    }
  }
  df
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------------
## Main loop: process every 2001 file and pair with its 2011 file
## ------------------------------------------------------------------

# All 2001 CSV files like "AP_2001.csv"
files_2001 <- list.files(dir_2001, pattern = "_2001\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

for (f01 in files_2001) {

  base_name <- basename(f01)           # e.g. "AP_2001.csv"
  state_code <- sub("_2001.*$", "", base_name)  # e.g. "AP"
  f11 <- file.path(dir_2011, paste0(state_code, "_2011.csv"))

  if (!file.exists(f11)) {
    message("No matching 2011 file for ", base_name, " (expected ", f11, ")")
    next
  }

  message("Merging ", base_name, " with ", basename(f11))

  # Read both years
  df01 <- read.csv(f01, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  df11 <- read.csv(f11, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Build normalized join keys
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------

  # Protect against missing columns
  required_keys <- c("State", "Area",
                     "Last_Residence", "Last_Residence_Type",
                     "Enumeration_Site_Type")

  missing_01 <- setdiff(required_keys, names(df01))
  missing_11 <- setdiff(required_keys, names(df11))

  if (length(missing_01) > 0) {
    warning("File ", base_name, " is missing key columns: ",
            paste(missing_01, collapse = ", "))
    next
  }
  if (length(missing_11) > 0) {
    warning("File ", basename(f11), " is missing key columns: ",
            paste(missing_11, collapse = ", "))
    next
  }

  # Normalize Area and other key strings
  df01$Area_norm <- clean_area(df01$Area)
  df11$Area_norm <- clean_area(df11$Area)

  df01$State                <- std_key(df01$State)
  df11$State                <- std_key(df11$State)
  df01$Last_Residence       <- std_key(df01$Last_Residence)
  df11$Last_Residence       <- std_key(df11$Last_Residence)
  df01$Last_Residence_Type  <- std_key(df01$Last_Residence_Type)
  df11$Last_Residence_Type  <- std_key(df11$Last_Residence_Type)
  df01$Enumeration_Site_Type <- std_key(df01$Enumeration_Site_Type)
  df11$Enumeration_Site_Type <- std_key(df11$Enumeration_Site_Type)

  # Keys we will actually join on
  join_keys <- c("State",
                 "Area_norm",
                 "Last_Residence",
                 "Last_Residence_Type",
                 "Enumeration_Site_Type")

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Convert numeric columns (remove commas etc.)
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  df01 <- to_numeric_cols(df01, exclude = c(join_keys, "Area"))
  df11 <- to_numeric_cols(df11, exclude = c(join_keys, "Area"))

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Add prefixes 2001_ and 2011_ to non key columns
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------

  other01 <- setdiff(names(df01), join_keys)
  other11 <- setdiff(names(df11), join_keys)

  # We will not prefix the join keys themselves
  # We will prefix everything else
  prefix_cols <- function(df, other, prefix) {
    new_names <- names(df)
    idx <- match(other, new_names)
    new_names[idx] <- paste0(prefix, other)
    names(df) <- new_names
    df
  }

  df01 <- prefix_cols(df01, other01, "2001_")
  df11 <- prefix_cols(df11, other11, "2011_")

  # After prefixing, join keys are still called State, Area_norm, etc
  # because we excluded them from other01 / other11

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Merge
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  merged <- merge(df01, df11, by = join_keys, all = TRUE)

    ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Create delta columns for matching 2001_*/2011_* numeric pairs
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------

  # Find common suffixes
  names01 <- grep("^2001_", names(merged), value = TRUE)
  names11 <- grep("^2011_", names(merged), value = TRUE)

  suf01 <- sub("^2001_", "", names01)
  suf11 <- sub("^2011_", "", names11)

  common_suf <- intersect(suf01, suf11)

  for (suf in common_suf) {
    c01 <- paste0("2001_", suf)
    c11 <- paste0("2011_", suf)
    delta_name <- paste0("delta_", suf)

    if (c01 %in% names(merged) && c11 %in% names(merged)) {
      v01 <- merged[[c01]]
      v11 <- merged[[c11]]

      # Try to coerce to numeric if not already
      if (!is.numeric(v01)) {
        v01 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", v01)))
      }
      if (!is.numeric(v11)) {
        v11 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", v11)))
      }

      # If both are completely non-numeric (all NA), skip
      if (all(is.na(v01)) && all(is.na(v11))) {
        next
      }

      merged[[delta_name]] <- v11 - v01
    }
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Write output
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------

  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(state_code, "_2001_2011_merged.csv"))
  write.csv(merged, out_file, row.names = FALSE)
  message("  -> written ", out_file)
}
```

```{r Merging Migration Data (rev.)}
## ------------------------------------------------------------------
## Setup
## ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Root directory that contains "2001" and "2011"
root_dir <- "/Users/Daevan/Downloads/Lab for Globalization and Shared Prosperity/Status Threat/Status Threat Data"

# IMPORTANT: avoid leading "/" inside file.path() so it stays relative to root_dir
dir_2001 <- file.path(root_dir, "Migration", "2001")
dir_2011 <- file.path(root_dir, "Migration", "2011")
out_dir  <- file.path(root_dir, "Migration", "Delta")

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------------
## Helpers
## ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Clean Area names so 2001 and 2011 match
clean_area <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  # Remove leading "STATE - " or "District - " (case insensitive)
  x <- gsub("(?i)^state\\s*-\\s*", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)^district\\s*-\\s*", "", x, perl = TRUE)

  # Remove trailing codes like " 01", " 02", "(01)", "(02)"
  x <- gsub("\\s*\\(?0*[0-9]{1,2}\\)?$", "", x)

  x <- trimws(x)
  toupper(x)
}

# Standardize key string columns (trim + upper)
std_key <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  toupper(trimws(x))
}

# Explicit Last_Residence canonicalization map (ONLY applied to Last_Residence)
last_residence_alias_map <- c(
  "A & N ISLANDS"         = "ANDAMAN & NICOBAR ISLANDS",
  "CHANDIGARGH"           = "CHANDIGARH",
  "CHHATISGARGH"          = "CHHATTISGARH",
  "COUNTRIES IN AMERICA"  = "COUNTRIES IN THE AMERICAS",
  "DELHI"                 = "NCT OF DELHI",
  "ODISHA"                = "ORISSA",
  "PONDICHERRY"           = "PUDUCHERRY",
  "UTTARAKHAND"           = "UTTARANCHAL",
  "UTTARAKHAND"           = "UTTRANCHAL"
)

canonicalize_last_residence <- function(x) {
  x_std <- std_key(x)  # trim + upper first
  repl <- unname(last_residence_alias_map[x_std])
  hit  <- !is.na(repl)
  x_std[hit] <- repl[hit]
  x_std
}

# Convert numeric-looking columns (with commas) to numeric
to_numeric_cols <- function(df, exclude = character()) {
  cols <- setdiff(names(df), exclude)
  for (nm in cols) {
    if (is.character(df[[nm]])) {
      tmp <- gsub(",", "", df[[nm]])
      suppressWarnings(num <- as.numeric(tmp))
      if (sum(!is.na(num)) > 0) {
        df[[nm]] <- num
      }
    }
  }
  df
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------------
## Main loop: process every 2001 file and pair with its 2011 file
## ------------------------------------------------------------------

files_2001 <- list.files(dir_2001, pattern = "_2001\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

for (f01 in files_2001) {

  base_name  <- basename(f01)                       # e.g. "AP_2001.csv"
  state_code <- sub("_2001.*$", "", base_name)      # e.g. "AP"
  f11        <- file.path(dir_2011, paste0(state_code, "_2011.csv"))

  if (!file.exists(f11)) {
    message("No matching 2011 file for ", base_name, " (expected ", f11, ")")
    next
  }

  message("Merging ", base_name, " with ", basename(f11))
  message("  Canonicalizing Last_Residence using alias map (e.g. DELHI -> NCT OF DELHI)")

  # Read both years
  df01 <- read.csv(f01, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  df11 <- read.csv(f11, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Protect against missing key columns
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  required_keys <- c("State", "Area",
                     "Last_Residence", "Last_Residence_Type",
                     "Enumeration_Site_Type")

  missing_01 <- setdiff(required_keys, names(df01))
  missing_11 <- setdiff(required_keys, names(df11))

  if (length(missing_01) > 0) {
    warning("File ", base_name, " is missing key columns: ",
            paste(missing_01, collapse = ", "))
    next
  }
  if (length(missing_11) > 0) {
    warning("File ", basename(f11), " is missing key columns: ",
            paste(missing_11, collapse = ", "))
    next
  }

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Preserve raw Last_Residence for transparency in output
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  df01$Last_Residence_raw <- df01$Last_Residence
  df11$Last_Residence_raw <- df11$Last_Residence

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Build normalized join keys
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------

  # Normalize Area for join
  df01$Area_norm <- clean_area(df01$Area)
  df11$Area_norm <- clean_area(df11$Area)

  # Standardize keys (State unchanged beyond trim+upper; Last_Residence canonicalized)
  df01$State                 <- std_key(df01$State)
  df11$State                 <- std_key(df11$State)

  df01$Last_Residence         <- canonicalize_last_residence(df01$Last_Residence)
  df11$Last_Residence         <- canonicalize_last_residence(df11$Last_Residence)

  df01$Last_Residence_Type    <- std_key(df01$Last_Residence_Type)
  df11$Last_Residence_Type    <- std_key(df11$Last_Residence_Type)

  df01$Enumeration_Site_Type  <- std_key(df01$Enumeration_Site_Type)
  df11$Enumeration_Site_Type  <- std_key(df11$Enumeration_Site_Type)

  # Join keys
  join_keys <- c("State",
                 "Area_norm",
                 "Last_Residence",
                 "Last_Residence_Type",
                 "Enumeration_Site_Type")

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Convert numeric columns (remove commas etc.)
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  df01 <- to_numeric_cols(df01, exclude = c(join_keys, "Area"))
  df11 <- to_numeric_cols(df11, exclude = c(join_keys, "Area"))

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Prefix non-key columns with 2001_ / 2011_
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  other01 <- setdiff(names(df01), join_keys)
  other11 <- setdiff(names(df11), join_keys)

  prefix_cols <- function(df, other, prefix) {
    new_names <- names(df)
    idx <- match(other, new_names)
    new_names[idx] <- paste0(prefix, other)
    names(df) <- new_names
    df
  }

  df01 <- prefix_cols(df01, other01, "2001_")
  df11 <- prefix_cols(df11, other11, "2011_")

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Merge
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  merged <- merge(df01, df11, by = join_keys, all = TRUE)

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Create delta columns for matching 2001_*/2011_* numeric pairs
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  names01 <- grep("^2001_", names(merged), value = TRUE)
  names11 <- grep("^2011_", names(merged), value = TRUE)

  suf01 <- sub("^2001_", "", names01)
  suf11 <- sub("^2011_", "", names11)

  common_suf <- intersect(suf01, suf11)

  for (suf in common_suf) {
    c01 <- paste0("2001_", suf)
    c11 <- paste0("2011_", suf)
    delta_name <- paste0("delta_", suf)

    if (c01 %in% names(merged) && c11 %in% names(merged)) {
      v01 <- merged[[c01]]
      v11 <- merged[[c11]]

      if (!is.numeric(v01)) v01 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", v01)))
      if (!is.numeric(v11)) v11 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", v11)))

      if (all(is.na(v01)) && all(is.na(v11))) next
      merged[[delta_name]] <- v11 - v01
    }
  }

  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Write output
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------------
  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(state_code, "_2001_2011_merged.csv"))
  write.csv(merged, out_file, row.names = FALSE)
  message("  -> written ", out_file)
}
```
